<div id="createPostModal" class="modal-overlay" style="display:none;">
    <div class="modal-content" style="max-width:440px; width:95%;">
        <div class="modal-title">Новый пост</div>

<!-- ★★★ ЕДИНОЕ ПРЕВЬЮ: фото + статистика (как в ленте) ★★★ -->
<div class="feed-post-content post-preview-content" id="postPreviewContent"
     onclick="document.getElementById('postPhotoInput').click()">

    <!-- Фото -->
    <div class="feed-post-image" id="postPreviewImage">
        <div class="upload-zone-placeholder">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-camera upload-zone-icon"></i>
            <div class="upload-zone-text">Нажмите, чтобы загрузить фото</div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Наложенная статистика (появляется после выбора тренировки) -->
    <div class="feed-post-body post-preview-body" id="postPreviewBody" style="display:none;">
        <div class="feed-post-title" id="postPreviewTitle">Тренировка</div>
        <div class="feed-post-stats">
            <div class="feed-post-stat">
                <span class="feed-post-stat-label">Время</span>
                <span class="feed-post-stat-value" id="postPreviewMinutes">0</span>
            </div>
            <div class="feed-post-stat">
                <span class="feed-post-stat-label">Упражнений</span>
                <span class="feed-post-stat-value" id="postPreviewExercises">0/0</span>
            </div>
            <div class="feed-post-stat">
                <span class="feed-post-stat-label">Прогресс</span>
                <span class="feed-post-stat-value" id="postPreviewXp">+0</span>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<input type="file" id="postPhotoInput" accept="image/*"
       style="display:none;" onchange="handlePostPhotoSelect(event)">

<!-- Выбор тренировки -->
<div style="text-align:left;margin-bottom: 0.5rem; margin-top: 0.5rem;">
    <label class="form-label">Тренировка</label>
    <select id="postWorkoutSelect" class="form-select"
            onchange="handlePostWorkoutChange()">
        <option value="">Загрузка...</option>
    </select>
</div>

<!-- Опция: прикрепить ссылку на тренировку -->
<div id="postShareLinkBlock" class="post-toggle-row" style="display:none;">
    <label class="post-checkbox-row">
        <input type="checkbox" id="postShareLinkCheckbox" checked
               onchange="_postShareLink = this.checked;">
        <span>Добавить ссылку на тренировку?</span>
    </label>
</div>

        <div style="display:flex; gap:0.5rem; margin-top:0.5rem;">
            <button class="btn btn-secondary" style="flex:1;"
                    onclick="closeModal('createPostModal')">Отмена</button>
            <button class="btn btn-primary" id="postPublishBtn" style="flex:1;"
                    onclick="publishPost()">Опубликовать</button>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- МОДАЛКА: ДОБАВИТЬ ЗАМЕР -->
<div id="addMeasurementModal" class="modal-overlay" style="display:none;">
    <div class="modal-content" style="max-width: 400px;">
        <div class="modal-title" id="measurementModalTitle">Новый замер</div>
        <p class="modal-text" style="margin-bottom:0.8rem;">
            Замеряй утром натощак, в одной и той же одежде - для честной динамики.
        </p>

<div class="form-row">
            <div class="form-group" style="text-align:left;">
                <label class="form-label">Рост (см)</label>
                <input type="number" id="measureHeight" class="form-input"
                    step="0.5" min="100" max="250" placeholder="—" />
            </div>
            <div class="form-group" style="text-align:left;">
                <label class="form-label">Вес (кг)</label>
                <input type="number" id="measureWeight" class="form-input"
                    step="0.1" min="20" max="500" placeholder="—" />
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="form-row">
            <div class="form-group" style="text-align:left;">
                <label class="form-label">Грудь (см)</label>
                <input type="number" id="measureChest" class="form-input"
                       step="0.5" min="30" max="300" placeholder="—" />
            </div>
            <div class="form-group" style="text-align:left;">
                <label class="form-label">Талия (см)</label>
                <input type="number" id="measureWaist" class="form-input"
                       step="0.5" min="30" max="300" placeholder="—" />
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="form-row">
            <div class="form-group" style="text-align:left;">
                <label class="form-label">Бёдра (см)</label>
                <input type="number" id="measureHips" class="form-input"
                       step="0.5" min="30" max="300" placeholder="—" />
            </div>
            <div class="form-group" style="text-align:left;">
                <label class="form-label">Бицепс (см)</label>
                <input type="number" id="measureArm" class="form-input"
                       step="0.5" min="10" max="100" placeholder="—" />
            </div>
        </div>

        <div style="display:flex; gap:0.5rem; margin-top:0.5rem;">
            <button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="closeModal('addMeasurementModal')" style="flex:1;">Отмена</button>
            <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="saveMeasurement()" style="flex:1;">Сохранить</button>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- МОДАЛКА: О БЛОКЕ ПРОГРЕСС ТЕЛА -->
<div id="bodyProgressInfoModal" class="modal-overlay" style="display:none;">
    <div class="modal-content" style="max-width: 420px;">
        <div class="modal-title">Прогресс тела</div>

        <p class="modal-text">
            Этот блок показывает, как меняются ваши параметры тела по месяцам.
        </p>

        <p class="modal-text">
            Каждая цветная линия - отдельный параметр. Все они рисуются на общей шкале, поэтому линии могут пересекаться - это нормально. Слева по вертикали - значения, снизу по горизонтали - даты понедельников месяца.
        </p>

        <p class="modal-text">
            Добавляйте замер раз в неделю или две, чтобы видеть честную динамику. Стрелки сверху переключают месяцы.
        </p>

        <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="scrollToBodyProgress()" style="margin-top:0.5rem;">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-chart-line"></i> Посмотреть данные
        </button>
        <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="closeModal('bodyProgressInfoModal')" style="margin-top:0.4rem;">
            Понятно
        </button>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- ===== МОДАЛКА: ЧТО НОВОГО ===== -->
<div id="changelogModal" class="modal-overlay" style="display:none;">
    <div class="modal-content" style="max-width: 480px; width: 95%; max-height: 85vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column;">

        <div style="text-align: center; margin-bottom: 0.8rem;">
            <div class="modal-title" style="margin-bottom: 0;">Обновление в SportApp</div>
        </div>

        <div class="scroll-wrapper" style="max-height: 50vh; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; border-radius: 12px;">
            <div id="changelogList" class="changelog-list"></div>
        </div>

        <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="closeChangelogModal()">
            Отлично!
        </button>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- ===== МОДАЛКА: СВЯЗЬ С АДМИНИСТРАЦИЕЙ ===== -->
<div id="supportModal" class="modal-overlay" style="display:none;">
    <div class="modal-content" style="max-width: 420px; width: 95%;">
        <div class="modal-title">Связь с администрацией</div>

        <div style="text-align:left;margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">
            <label class="form-label" for="supportSubject">Тема</label>
            <select id="supportSubject" class="form-input" style="max-height: 40px;">
                <option value="bug">Ошибка в приложении</option>
                <option value="question">Вопрос</option>
                <option value="idea">Идея / предложение</option>
                <option value="premium">Вопрос по PREMIUM</option>
                <option value="other">Другое</option>
            </select>
        </div>

        <div style="text-align:left;margin-bottom: 0rem;">
            <!-- ★★★ СЧЁТЧИК НА ОДНОЙ СТРОКЕ С ЗАГОЛОВКОМ ★★★ -->
            <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline;">
                <label class="form-label" for="supportMessage">Сообщение</label>
                <span style="font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--slate);margin-right: 0.5rem;">
                    <span id="supportCharCount">0</span> / 1000
                </span>
            </div>
            <textarea id="supportMessage" class="form-input" 
                      style="min-height: 100px; resize: vertical; max-height: 200px;"
                      placeholder="Опишите вашу проблему..." 
                      maxlength="1000"></textarea>
        </div>

        <div style="text-align:left; margin-bottom: 1rem;">
            <label class="form-label">Контакт для ответа (необязательно)</label>
            <input type="text" id="supportContact" class="form-input" 
                   placeholder="Telegram, почта или телефон" maxlength="60" />
        </div>

        <div style="display:flex; gap:0.5rem;">
            <button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="closeModal('supportModal')" style="flex:1;">Отмена</button>
            <button class="btn btn-primary" id="supportSendBtn" style="flex:1;">Отправить</button>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

    <!-- ===== МОДАЛКА: СЕРИЯ ТРЕНИРОВОК ===== -->
<div id="streakModal" class="modal-overlay" style="display:none;">
    <div class="modal-content" style="max-width: 420px; width: 95%;">
        <div class="modal-title">Серия тренировок</div>

<div style="text-align: center; margin: 1rem 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.8rem;">
    <div style="font-size: 3rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent); line-height: 1;" id="streakModalValue">0</div>
    <div style="font-size: 3rem; color: var(--accent); line-height: 1;">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-fire"></i>
    </div>
</div>

        <p class="modal-text" id="streakModalText1">Тренируйтесь каждый день, чтобы увеличить серию.</p>
        <p class="modal-text" id="streakModalText2">Если пропустить день — серия сбросится.</p>
        <p class="modal-text" id="streakModalText3">За длинные серии вы получаете достижения и XP.</p>

        <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="closeModal('streakModal')">
            Понятно
        </button>
    </div>
</div>

    <!-- ===== МОДАЛКА: ИНВЕНТАРЬ ===== -->
<div id="inventoryModal" class="modal-overlay" style="display:none;">
    <div class="modal-content" style="max-width: 420px; width: 95%;">
        <div class="modal-title">Ваш инвентарь</div>
        <p class="modal-text" style="margin-bottom: 1rem;">
            Отметьте, какой инвентарь у вас есть. Это поможет подбирать подходящие тренировки.
        </p>

<div class="inventory-grid" style="margin-bottom: 1rem;">
    <button type="button" class="inventory-btn" data-inventory="dumbbells" onclick="toggleInventory(this)">
        <span class="inventory-name">Гантели</span>
    </button>
    <button type="button" class="inventory-btn" data-inventory="mat" onclick="toggleInventory(this)">
        <span class="inventory-name">Коврик</span>
    </button>
    <button type="button" class="inventory-btn" data-inventory="pullup" onclick="toggleInventory(this)">
        <span class="inventory-name">Турник</span>
    </button>
</div>

        <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="saveInventoryFromModal()">
            Сохранить
        </button>
    </div>
</div>

        <!-- ★★★ ОПИСАНИЕ (заполняется из JS) ★★★ -->

        <p class="modal-text" id="muscleModalText2"></p>
        <p class="modal-text" id="muscleModalText3"></p>

        <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="closeModal('muscleGroupsModal')">

        </button>
    </div>
</div>

    <!-- ===== МОДАЛКА: ВЫБОР ЯЗЫКА ===== -->
<div id="languageModal" class="modal-overlay" style="display:none;">
    <div class="modal-content" style="max-width: 400px;">
        <div class="modal-title">Язык приложения</div>
        <p class="modal-text" style="margin-bottom: 1rem;">
            Выберите язык интерфейса.
        </p>
        
        <div class="theme-options-container">
            <!-- Русский -->
            <div class="language-option language-option-active" data-language="ru" onclick="selectLanguage('ru')">
                <div class="language-icon">
                    <span>🇷🇺</span>
                </div>
                <div class="theme-option-info">
                    <div class="settings-title">Русский</div>
                    <div class="settings-desc">Русский язык интерфейса</div>
                </div>
                <div class="theme-option-check">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i>
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <!-- Английский -->
            <div class="language-option" data-language="en" onclick="selectLanguage('en')">
                <div class="language-icon">
                    <span>🇺🇸</span>
                </div>
                <div class="theme-option-info">
                    <div class="settings-title">English</div>
                    <div class="settings-desc">English interface</div>
                </div>
                <div class="theme-option-check">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        
        <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="applyLanguage()">Готово</button>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- ===== МОДАЛКА: ПЕРВЫЕ ЗАДАНИЯ ===== -->
<div id="taskHelpModal" class="modal-overlay" style="display:none;">
    <div class="modal-content" style="max-width:400px;">
        <div class="modal-title" style="margin-bottom: 0rem;" id="taskHelpTitle">Первый шаг</div>
        <div style="text-align:center; font-size:3rem;" id="taskHelpIcon">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-dumbbell" style="color: var(--accent);"></i>
        </div>
        <p class="modal-text" id="taskHelpText" style="margin-bottom:1rem;">
            Для прохождения задания нужно выполнить тренировку.
        </p>
        <div style="display:flex; gap:0.5rem;">
            <button class="btn btn-secondary" id="taskHelpCancelBtn" onclick="closeModal('taskHelpModal')" style="flex:1;">Отмена</button>
            <button class="btn btn-primary" id="taskHelpActionBtn" style="flex:1;">Перейти</button>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- ===== МОДАЛКА: ЕЖЕДНЕВНЫЕ ЗАДАНИЯ (ДРУЗЬЯ) ===== -->
<div id="dailyTaskHelpModal" class="modal-overlay" style="display:none;">
    <div class="modal-content" style="max-width:400px;">
        <div class="modal-title" style="margin-bottom: 0rem;" id="dailyTaskHelpTitle">Дружный</div>
        <div style="text-align:center; font-size:3rem;" id="dailyTaskHelpIcon">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-user-group" style="color: var(--accent);"></i>
        </div>
        <p class="modal-text" id="dailyTaskHelpText" style="margin-bottom:1rem;">
            Для прохождения задания "Дружный" нужно выбрать любую тренировку, нажать на кнопку "Совместная", выбрать друга и выполнить совместную тренировку.
        </p>
        <div style="display:flex; gap:0.5rem;">
            <button class="btn btn-secondary" id="dailyTaskHelpCancelBtn" style="flex:1;" onclick="closeModal('dailyTaskHelpModal')">Отмена</button>
            <button class="btn btn-primary" id="dailyTaskHelpActionBtn" style="flex:1;">Перейти</button>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<div id="levelInfoModal" class="modal-overlay" style="display:none;">
    <div class="modal-content" style="max-width:420px;">
        <div class="modal-title">УРОВЕНЬ ПРОФИЛЯ</div>
        <p class="modal-text" style="margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">
Ваш уровень растёт с каждой тренировкой.
        </p>
        <div class="level-block" style="margin: 0rem 0rem 0.2rem 0rem;">
            <div class="level-header">
                <div class="level-left">
                    <span class="level-lvl" id="levelInfoLvl">1 LVL</span>
                </div>
                <div class="level-center">
                    <span class="level-title" id="levelInfoTitle">НАЧИНАЮЩИЙ</span>
                </div>
                <div class="level-right">
                    <span class="level-progress-text" id="levelInfoProgress">0/100XP</span>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="level-bar">
                <div class="level-fill" id="levelInfoFill" style="width:0%;"></div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <p class="modal-text" style="margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">
            Это основная статистика, по которой работает рейтинг пользователей, 
            с помощью него вы можете соревноваться с друзьями!
            Продолжайте тренироваться, чтобы достигать новых вершин!
        </p>
        <button class="btn btn-primary" id="levelInfoOkBtn">Понятно</button>
    </div>
</div>

    <div class="modal-content" style="max-width: 400px;">

        </p>
        
        <div class="theme-options-container">
            <!-- Светлая тема -->
            <div class="theme-option theme-option-active" data-theme="light" onclick="selectTheme('light')">

                </div>
                <div class="theme-option-info">

                                    <!-- Системная тема -->

                    <i class="fa-solid fa-cloud-sun-rain" style="color: var(--gold)"></i>
                </div>
                <div class="theme-option-info">

                </div>
            </div>
            
            <!-- Тёмная тема -->
            <div class="theme-option" style="background: var(--bg-primary)" data-theme="dark" onclick="selectTheme('dark')">
                <div class="theme-option-iconDark">

                <div class="theme-option-info">
                    <div class="settings-titleDark">Тёмная</div>

                </div>
                <div class="theme-option-check">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        
        <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="applyTheme()">Готово</button>
    </div>
</div>

            <!-- Шаг 4: Добавить -->
            <div class="pwa-ios-step">
                <div class="pwa-ios-step-num">4</div>
                <div class="pwa-ios-step-text">
                    Нажмите <strong>«Добавить»</strong>
                    в правом верхнем углу

            </div>

        </div>

<script>
// =================== SERVICE WORKER ===================
if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
    window.addEventListener('load', () => {
        navigator.serviceWorker.register('sw.js', { scope: './' })
            .then(reg => {
                console.log('✅ SW зарегистрирован:', reg.scope);

                // ★★★ Проверяем обновления при возврате на вкладку ★★★
                document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
                    if (!document.hidden) reg.update();
                });
            })
            .catch(err => console.warn('SW ошибка:', err));
    });
}
</script> 
</body>
</html>

/* ===================RESET И ОСНОВНЫЕ СТИЛИ ==================== */
* {   
    margin: 0; 
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

body {
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
    background: #f8fafc;
    color: #0f172a;
    min-height: 100vh;
    line-height: 1.6;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    -webkit-touch-callout: none;
    overscroll-behavior: none;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    padding-top: calc(env(safe-area-inset-top, 40px) - 10px);
}
 
/* ===================ПЕРЕМЕННЫЕ ==================== */
:root {
    /* ── ТЕНИ ── */
    --shadow-card:
        0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04),
        0 3px 10px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);
    --shadow-float:
        0 4px 12px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08),
        0 20px 60px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.15);
    --shadow-card-dark:
        0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3),
        0 3px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
    --shadow-float-dark:
        0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4),
        0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);

    /* ── ЦВЕТА ── */
    --accent: #DC143C;
    --accent-dark: #B01030;
    --accent-light: #FFE8EC;
    --dark: #0F172A;
    --slate: #64748B;
    --light: #F8FAFC;
    --white: #FFFFFF;
    --danger: #EF4444;
    --gold: #F7C948;
    --light-grey: #E2E8F0;

    --bg-primary: #0F172A;
    --bg-secondary: #1E293B;
    --text-primary: #94A3B8;
    --text-secondary: #64748B;
    --border-color: #334155;
    --shadow-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
}

/* ===================ТЕМЫ ==================== */
.theme-red { --accent: #DC143C; --accent-dark: #4A0616; --accent-light: #ffe5ea; }
.theme-orange { --accent: #FF6B35; --accent-dark: #6B2A0D; --accent-light: #ffe3d0; }
.theme-yellow { --accent: #F7C948; --accent-dark: #6A5510; --accent-light: #fff2c5; }
.theme-green { --accent: #2ECC71; --accent-dark: #0B4A28; --accent-light: #ddffda; }
.theme-darkgreen { --accent: #1A7A3A; --accent-dark: #082A14; --accent-light: #b3dfc4; }
.theme-blue { --accent: #3498DB; --accent-dark: #0E3D5A; --accent-light: #D4EAF7; }
.theme-darkblue { --accent: #1a237e; --accent-dark: #0a1030; --accent-light: #D6D9F0; }
.theme-purple { --accent: #9B59B6; --accent-dark: #3A1A4A; --accent-light: #EAD4F0; }
.theme-pink { --accent: #E91E8C; --accent-dark: #5A0D30; --accent-light: #ffe3f2; }
.theme-gray { --accent: #607D8B; --accent-dark: #0F172A; --accent-light: #e7e7e7; }

/* ===================СТРАНИЦЫ ==================== */
.page { display: none; }
.page-active { display: block; }

/* ===================КОНТЕЙНЕРЫ ==================== */
.dashboard-container {
    max-width: 500px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0rem 1rem 100px;
}

/* ===================ЗАГОЛОВКИ ==================== */
.dashboard-header {
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 0rem;
    margin-top: 0px;
}

.dashboard-title {
    font-size: 1.8rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--dark);
    word-break: break-word;
}

.profile-tab-content { display: none; }
.profile-tab-content-active { display: block; }

/* ===================ЕДИНЫЙ СТИЛЬ ДЛЯ СЕКЦИЙ (БЛОКОВ) ==================== */
.section-block {
    background: var(--light);
    border-radius: 16px;
    margin: 0 0 0.5rem 0;
}

.section-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    user-select: none;
}

.section-title {
    flex: 1;
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--dark);
    margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
    margin-top: 0.2rem;
}

.section-title0-10 {
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--dark);
    margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
    margin-top: 0.2rem;
}

.section-toggle {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    border: none;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--slate);
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.section-block.open .section-toggle { transform: rotate(90deg); }

.section-drag {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    border: none;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--slate);
    font-size: 1rem;
    cursor: grab;
    display: none;              /* ← по умолчанию скрыта */
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    touch-action: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

.section-drag:active { cursor: grabbing; }

/* В режиме редактирования — показываем (правило уже есть) */
.editing .section-drag { display: flex !important; }

.section-body {
    overflow: hidden;
    max-height: 0;
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    transition: max-height 0.3s ease-out,
                opacity 0.25s ease-out,
                margin 0.3s ease-out;
}

.section-block.open .section-body {
    max-height: 3000px;
    opacity: 1;
    pointer-events: auto;
    margin-top: 0.2rem;
}

/* ===================ЕДИНЫЙ СТИЛЬ ДЛЯ КАРТОЧЕК ЭЛЕМЕНТОВ ==================== */
.item-grid {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.5rem;
}

.item-card {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    background: var(--white);
    padding: 0.5rem;
    border-radius: 16px;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
    cursor: pointer;
    border: 2px solid transparent;
}

#worldLeaderboard,
#friendsLeaderboard,
.section-block[data-block-id="world-leaderboard"] .section-body,
.section-block[data-block-id="friends-leaderboard"] .section-body {
    overflow: visible !important;
}

.item-card-light {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    background: var(--light);
    padding: 0.5rem 1rem 0.5rem 0.5rem;
    border-radius: 16px;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
    cursor: pointer;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--light-grey);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .item-card-light {
    background: var(--bg-primary);
    border: 1.5px solid var(--border-color);
}

.item-icon {
    width: 60px;
    height: 60px;
    min-width: 60px;
    border-radius: 14px;
    background: var(--accent-light);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.item-icon img {
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    object-fit: contain;
}

.item-number {
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    color: var(--accent);
}

.item-info { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

.item-title {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--dark);
    margin: 0;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.item-desc {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: var(--slate);
    margin: 0;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.item-action {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    border: none;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--light-grey);
    font-size: 1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.item-actionXP {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    border: none;
    white-space: nowrap;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--accent);
    font-size: 1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    padding-right: 0.5rem;
}

/* ===================ЕДИНЫЙ СТИЛЬ ДЛЯ УПРАЖНЕНИЙ ==================== */
.exercise-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 1rem;
    background: var(--white);
    padding: 1rem;
    border-radius: 16px;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
    border: 2px solid transparent;
}

.exercise-status {
    width: 60px;
    height: 60px;
    min-width: 60px;
    border-radius: 14px;
    background: var(--accent-light);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.exercise-number {
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    color: var(--accent);
}

.exercise-check {
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    border: 2px solid var(--slate);
    background: var(--white);
    display: none;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    color: var(--white);
}

.exercise-check.completed {
    background: var(--accent);
    border-color: var(--accent);
}

.exercise-info { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

.exercise-name {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--dark);
    margin: 0;
    word-break: break-word;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.exercise-details {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: var(--slate);
    margin: 0;
    margin-top: 0.1rem;
    word-break: break-word;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.exercise-edit {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    border: none;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--slate);
    font-size: 1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.exercise-edit:active { opacity: 0.6; }

/* ===================ЕДИНЫЙ СТИЛЬ ДЛЯ РЕДАКТИРУЕМЫХ УПРАЖНЕНИЙ ==================== */
.edit-exercise-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    background: var(--white);
    padding: 0.5rem;
    border-radius: 16px;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
    border: 2px solid transparent;
    cursor: default;
}

.edit-drag-handle {
    color: var(--slate);
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    cursor: grab;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    line-height: 0.4;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
}

.edit-exercise-icon {
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    object-fit: contain;
    display: block;
}

.edit-drag-handle span { display: block; font-size: 0.8rem; }

.edit-exercise-info { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

.edit-exercise-name {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--dark);
    margin: 0;
    word-break: break-word;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.edit-exercise-details {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: var(--slate);
    margin: 0;
    margin-top: 0.1rem;
    word-break: break-word;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.edit-exercise-actions { display: flex; }

.edit-exercise-actions button {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: none;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--slate);
    font-size: 1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.edit-exercise-actions .edit-btn { color: var(--accent); }
.edit-exercise-actions .delete-btn { color: var(--danger); }

.edit-exercise-item.dragging {
    opacity: 0.4;
    border-color: var(--accent);
}

.edit-exercise-item.drag-over {
    border-color: var(--accent);
    background: var(--accent-light);
}

/* ===================ЕДИНЫЙ СТИЛЬ ДЛЯ КНОПОК ==================== */
.btn {
    display: inline-block;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    padding: 0.4rem;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 10px;
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-align: center;
    transition: none;
}

.btn-primary {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--white);
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    border-bottom: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 80%, black);
}

.btn-secondary {
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--accent);
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    border: 2px solid var(--accent);
}

.btn-danger {
    background: var(--danger);
    color: var(--white);
    border: none;
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    border-bottom: 3px solid #C61236;
}

.search-btn {
    padding: 0.6rem;
    white-space: nowrap;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    width: 34px;
    height: 34px;
    max-width: 34px;
    max-height: 34px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--white);
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1;
    border-bottom: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 80%, black);
}

.search-btn i { font-size: 0.9rem; }

.btn-block { display: block; width: 100%; }
.btn-center { margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; }

.btn-sm {
    padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    border-radius: 6px;
}

/* ===================ЕДИНЫЙ СТИЛЬ ДЛЯ ВКЛАДОК ==================== */
.tabs {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    background: var(--light);
    padding: 0rem;
    border-radius: 14px;
    width: 100%;
    margin: 0.4rem 0;
}

.tab-btn {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 0.6rem;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 10px;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    cursor: pointer;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--slate);
}

.tab-btn:active { opacity: 0.7; }

.tab-btn-active {
    background: var(--white);
    color: var(--accent);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
}

.tab-content { display: none; }
.tab-content-active { display: block; }

/* ===================ЕДИНЫЙ СТИЛЬ ДЛЯ ФОРМ ==================== */
.form-group { margin-bottom: 1rem; }

.form-label {
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    margin-left: 0.2rem;
    color: var(--dark);
}

.form-label-small {
    font-weight: 400;
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    margin-left: 0.4rem;
    color: var(--slate);
}

.form-input {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 0.6rem;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--light-grey);
    border-radius: 10px;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    background: #FAFCFF;
    color: #0F172A;
    max-height: 34px;
}

.form-input:focus {
    outline: none;
    border-color: var(--accent);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent);
}

.form-input.error {
    border-color: var(--danger);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.06);
}

.form-actions { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.form-actions .btn { flex: 1; }

.form-row { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; }
.form-row .form-group { flex: 1; }

/* =================== МОДАЛЬНЫЕ ОКНА (С АНИМАЦИЕЙ) ==================== */
.modal-overlay {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    z-index: 2000;
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    transition: opacity 0.3s ease, visibility 0.3s ease;
}

.modal-overlay.modal-overlay-visible {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    pointer-events: auto;
}

.modal-content {
    background: var(--white);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 1rem;
    max-width: 500px;
    width: 95%;
    text-align: center;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-float);
    max-height: 90vh;
    overflow-y: auto;
    transform: translateY(60px) scale(0.95);
    opacity: 0;
    transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1),
                opacity 0.6s ease;
}

.modal-overlay.modal-overlay-visible .modal-content {
    transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
    opacity: 1;
}

.modal-overlay.modal-overlay-closing .modal-content {
    transform: translateY(-60px) scale(0.95);
    opacity: 0;
    transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1),
                opacity 0.6s ease;
}

.modal-overlay.modal-overlay-closing {
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.modal-title {
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--dark);
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: visible;
    max-width: 100%;
}

.modal-icon {
    font-size: 3rem;
    color: var(--accent);
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.modal-text {
    color: var(--slate);
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.modal-buttons { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; }
.modal-buttons .btn { flex: 1; }

/* ===================СТАТИСТИКА ==================== */
.stats-tab-content { display: none; }
.stats-tab-content-active { display: block; }

.stats-summary {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
    margin-top: 0.5rem;
}

.stats-summaryMOD {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.6rem;
    background-color: var(--light);
    border-radius: 12px;
    width: 100%;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--light-grey);
}

.stats-summaryMOD .stat-card {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 0.8rem 0.3rem;
    background: var(--white);
    border-radius: 14px;
    text-align: center;
    min-height: 70px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-top: 3px solid var(--accent);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
    width: 100%;
}

.stats-summaryMOD .stat-label {
    display: block;
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--accent);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.3px;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.stats-summaryMOD .stat-number {
    display: block;
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--dark);
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    max-width: 100%;
}

.stat-card {
    background: var(--white);
    padding: 0.8rem;
    border-radius: 12px;
    text-align: center;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
    border-top: 3px solid var(--accent);
}

#statsSummary,
#globalStatsContainer,
.section-block .section-body {
    overflow: visible !important;
}

.stat-label {
    display: block;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--accent);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.stat-number {
    display: block;
    font-size: 1.4rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--dark);
}

.stat-list {
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.3rem;
}

.stat-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    background: var(--white);
    padding: 0.3rem 0.8rem;
    border-radius: 6px;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
}

.stat-name {
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: var(--dark);
    min-width: 50px;
    word-break: break-word;
}

.stat-bar {
    flex: 1;
    height: 5px;
    background: var(--light-grey);
    border-radius: 4px;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.stat-fill {
    width: 0%;
    height: 100%;
    background: var(--accent);
    border-radius: 4px;
    animation: fillBar 3s ease;
}

@keyframes fillBar {
    from { width: 0%; }
}

.stat-count {
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: var(--accent);
    min-width: 30px;
    text-align: right;
}

.item-xp {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--accent);
    padding-right: 0.3rem;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.item-card.current-user {
    border: 2px solid var(--accent);
}

/* ===================ИСТОРИЯ ТРЕНИРОВОК ==================== */
.scroll-wrapper {
    padding: 0.5rem;         /* ← вместо 0 0 0.5rem */
    max-height: 380px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
    margin: -0.5rem;         /* ← компенсируем визуально */
}

.scroll-wrapper::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
    width: 0px;
    height: 0px;
}

.scroll-wrapper-modal {
    max-height: 380px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
    background-color: var(--light);
    padding: 0.5rem;
    border-radius: 16px;
}

body.theme-dark-mode .scroll-wrapper-modal {
    max-height: 380px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
    background-color: var(--bg-primary);
    padding: 0.5rem;
    border-radius: 16px;
}

.scroll-wrapper-modal::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
    width: 0px;
    height: 0px;
}

.history-list {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.5rem;
}

.history-item {
    background: var(--white);
    padding: 0.6rem 1rem;
    border-radius: 10px;
    border-left: 4px solid var(--accent);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
}

.history-item-title {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--dark);
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    overflow: hidden;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.history-item-details {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: var(--slate);
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    overflow: hidden;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.history-item-date {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: var(--slate);
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.history-item-header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
}

/* =================== КАЛЕНДАРЬ ==================== */
.calendar-container {
    background: var(--white);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 0.5rem;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
}

.calendar-nav {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.btn-calendar-nav {
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    color: var(--slate);
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0.3rem;
    border-radius: 8px;
}

.calendar-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr);
    gap: 4px;
}

.calendar-weekday {
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--slate);
    padding: 0.2rem 0;
}

#calendarDays {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr);
    gap: 4px;
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
}

.calendar-day {
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--dark);
    padding: 0.5rem 0;
    border-radius: 8px;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.calendar-day-has-workout-1 {
    background: var(--accent-light);
    color: var(--dark);
    border-radius: 8px;
}

.calendar-day-has-workout-2 {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--white);
    border-radius: 8px;
}

.calendar-day-today {
    border: 2px solid var(--accent);
    border-radius: 8px;
}

.calendar-empty { visibility: hidden; }

/* ===================ПРОФИЛЬ ==================== */
.profile-card {
    position: relative;
    background: var(--white);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 1rem 1rem;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
}

.profile-avatar {
    width: 80px;
    height: 80px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--white);
    font-size: 2.2rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin: 0.2rem auto 0.2rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
}

.profile-avatar img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: contain;
    display: block;
    border-radius: 50%;
}

/* ★★★ ВНУТРЕННЯЯ АКЦЕНТНАЯ ОБВОДКА ★★★ */
.profile-avatar::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    border-radius: 50%;
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px var(--accent);
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 2;
}

/* ★★★ В тёмной теме ★★★ */
body.theme-dark-mode .profile-avatar {
    background: var(--accent);
}

.profile-name {
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: 750;
    color: var(--dark);
    word-break: break-word;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.profile-email {
    text-align: center;
    color: var(--slate);
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
    word-break: break-all;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.profile-info {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: left;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    color: var(--dark);
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    padding: 0.6rem 0.6rem 0.6rem 1rem;
    background: var(--light);
    border-radius: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    word-break: break-word;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.profile-info i { color: var(--accent); }
.profile-info strong { font-weight: 400; color: var(--slate); }

/* ===================УРОВЕНЬ / ПРОГРЕСС-БАР ==================== */
.level-block {
    background: var(--light);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 0.5rem 1rem 1rem;
    margin: 0.2rem 0 0.5rem 0;
    cursor: pointer;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--light-grey);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .level-block {
    border: 1.5px solid var(--border-color);
}

.level-header {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    justify-content: space-between;
    margin-bottom: 0rem;
    min-height: 1.8rem;
}

.level-left { flex: 0 0 auto; z-index: 2; }

.level-center {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    top: 0;
    text-align: center;
    z-index: 1;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.level-center .level-title { display: inline-block; }

.level-right { flex: 0 0 auto; z-index: 2; text-align: right; }

.level-lvl {
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--slate);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.3px;
}

.level-title {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--dark);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.level-progress-text {
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--slate);
}

.level-bar {
    width: 100%;
    height: 6px;
    background: var(--light-grey);
    border-radius: 4px;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
}

.level-fill {
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: var(--accent);
    animation: fillBar 3s ease;
}

/* ===================МОДАЛКА ЗАДАНИЙ ==================== */
.settings-block-task {
    background: var(--white);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 0rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.settings-item-task {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 0.5rem 0rem;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--light-grey)!important;
    width: auto;
}

.settings-item-task:last-child { border-bottom: none !important; }

/* ===================НАСТРОЙКИ ==================== */
.settings-block {
    background: var(--white);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 0.5rem 0;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
    overflow: hidden;
}

.settings-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 0.5rem 0rem;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--light-grey)!important;
    margin: 0 1rem;
    width: auto;
}

.settings-item:last-child { border-bottom: none !important; }

.settings-icon {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    min-width: 36px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: var(--accent-light);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: var(--accent);
    font-size: 1rem;
}

.settings-icon i.fa-crown { color: #F7C948; }

.settings-icon-danger {
    background: #ffe5ea !important;
    color: #EF4444 !important;
}

.settings-info { flex: 1; min-width: 0; text-align: left; }

.settings-title {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--dark);
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.settings-desc {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: var(--slate);
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.settings-action {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    border: none;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--light-grey);
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.task-checkbox {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    border: none;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--light-grey);
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    cursor: default;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    padding: 0;
}

.task-checkbox .fa-square-check { color: var(--accent) !important; }
.task-checkbox .fa-square { color: var(--light-grey) !important; }
.settings-item-task .fa-square-check { color: var(--accent) !important; }
.settings-item-task .fa-square { color: var(--light-grey) !important; }

/* ===================ДРУЗЬЯ ==================== */
.friends-list-block {
    background: transparent;
    border-radius: 0;
    padding: 1rem;
    border-radius: 16px;
    box-shadow: none;
    background-color: var(--white);
    width: 100%;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
}

.friend-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.8rem;
    background: var(--white);
    padding: 0.8rem;
    border-radius: 16px;
    cursor: pointer;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
    border-left: 4px solid var(--accent);
}

.friend-itemMOD {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.8rem;
    background: var(--white);
    padding: 0.8rem 0.8rem;
    border-radius: 16px;
    cursor: pointer;
    border: 2px solid var(--light-grey);
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.friend-itemMOD.selected,
body.theme-dark-mode .friend-itemMOD.selected {
    border: 2px solid var(--accent);
}

.friend-itemMOD .friend-info { text-align: left; flex: 1; }
.friend-itemMOD .friend-info strong,
.friend-itemMOD .friend-info span {
    display: block;
    text-align: left;
}

/* ===== РЕЗУЛЬТАТЫ ПОИСКА ===== */
.friend-result-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.8rem;
    background: var(--light);
    padding: 0.8rem 0.8rem;
    border-radius: 16px;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
    border: 1px solid var(--light-grey);
}

.friend-result-item .friend-avatar {
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    min-width: 44px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--accent-light);
    color: var(--accent);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.friend-result-item .friend-result-info {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-width: 0;
}

.friend-result-item .friend-result-info strong {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--dark);
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.friend-result-item .friend-result-info span {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: var(--slate);
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.friend-result-item .btn {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    width: auto;
    min-width: 80px;
    padding: 0.4rem 0.8rem;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    border-radius: 8px;
}

.friend-result-item .btn-sm {
    padding: 0.3rem 0.5rem;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    min-width: 70px;
}

.friend-result-item .btn-sm:disabled {
    opacity: 0.6;
    cursor: default;
    pointer-events: none;
}

/* ===== ЗАЯВКИ В ДРУЗЬЯ ===== */
.friend-request-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap:0.8rem;
    background: var(--white);
    padding: 0.8rem 0.8rem;
    border-radius: 16px;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
    border-left: 4px solid var(--accent);
}

.friend-request-item .friend-avatar {
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    min-width: 44px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--accent-light);
    color: var(--accent);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.friend-request-item .friend-result-info {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-width: 0;
}

.friend-request-item .friend-result-info strong {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--dark);
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.friend-request-item .friend-result-info span {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: var(--slate);
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.friend-request-item .btn {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    width: auto;
    padding: 0.3rem 0.8rem;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    border-radius: 8px;
    min-width: 60px;
}

.friend-request-item .btn-sm {
    padding: 0.3rem 0.5rem;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
}

.friend-request-item > div { display: flex; flex-shrink: 0; }

/* ===== ДРУЗЬЯ В СПИСКЕ ===== */
.friend-info {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-width: 0;
}

.friend-info strong {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--dark);
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.friend-info span {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: var(--slate);
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.friend-delete-btn {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    border: none;
    background: transparent;
    color: #EF4444;
    font-size: 1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    border-radius: 50%;
}

/* ===== ПУСТЫЕ СОСТОЯНИЯ ===== */
.empty-state {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 0.5rem 1rem 1rem 1rem;
    background: var(--white);
    border-radius: 12px;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
}

.empty-icon { font-size: 2.5rem; display: block; }

.empty-title {
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--dark);
}

.empty-text {
    color: var(--slate);
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

/* ===== АВАТАР ДРУГА ===== */
.friend-avatar {
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--accent-light);
    color: var(--accent);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 1rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.friend-profile-avatar {
    width: 72px;
    height: 72px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--white);
    font-size: 2rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin: 0 auto 0.3rem;
}

.friend-profile-email {
    color: var(--slate);
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    text-align: center;
    word-break: break-all;
}

/* ===================ПОИСК ==================== */
.search-container {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    width: 100%;
}

.search-input {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 0.6rem;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--light-grey);
    border-radius: 10px;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    background: #FAFCFF;
    color: #0F172A;
    min-width: 0;
    max-height: 34px;
}

.search-input:focus {
    outline: none;
    border-color: var(--accent);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent);
}

.search-btn {
    padding: 0.6rem 1rem;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    white-space: nowrap;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    width: auto;
}

/* ===================ВЫБОР ЗНАЧКА ==================== */
.icon-picker {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    background: none;
    border-radius: 16px;
}

.icon-pickerMOD {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin-top: 0.3rem;
}

.icon-option {
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    border: 2px solid var(--light-grey);
    background: var(--light);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0.3rem;
}

.icon-option-active {
    border-color: var(--accent);
}

.icon-option img {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    object-fit: contain;
}

/* ===================ВЫБОР ЦВЕТА ==================== */
.color-picker {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 0.5rem 0;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.color-btn {
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 2px solid var(--light-grey);
    cursor: pointer;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.color-btn-active { border-color: var(--dark); }

/* ===================ВХОД И РЕГИСТРАЦИЯ ==================== */
.auth-container {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 400px;
    padding: 1rem;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    min-height: 100vh;
    height: 100vh;
    justify-content: center;
    padding-top: 20vh;
    margin-top: -20vh;
}

.auth-title {
    font-size: 4rem;
    font-weight: 800;
    text-align: center;
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    background: var(--accent);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    background-clip: text;
}

.auth-card { background: none; width: 100%; }

.form-label-large {
    display: block;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 1.3rem;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
    color: var(--dark);
}

.auth-switch {
    margin-top: 0.4rem;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: var(--slate);
    font-style: italic;
}

.auth-switch a {
    color: var(--dark);
    text-decoration: none;
    text-underline-offset: 2px;
    font-weight: 500;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-style: italic;
}

/* =================== ПОЛОСКИ ШАГОВ РЕГИСТРАЦИИ ==================== */
.step-dots {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    width: 90%;
    max-width: 400px;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.step-dot {
    flex: 1;
    height: 6px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: var(--light-grey);
    transition: background 0.4s ease;
}

.step-dot.active { background: var(--accent); }

body.theme-dark-mode .step-dot { background: var(--bg-secondary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .step-dot.active { background: var(--accent); }

/* =================== ПОЛЕ ВВОДА С КНОПКОЙ ==================== */
.input-with-btn {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    width: 100%;
    height: 34px;
    min-height: 34px;
}

.input-with-btn .form-input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

.btn-submit-arrow {
    border: none;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--white);
    font-weight: 300;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    line-height: 1;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 34px;
    height: 34px;
    min-width: 34px;
    min-height: 34px;
    border-bottom: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 80%, black);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .btn-submit-arrow {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--light-grey);
}

.input-with-text {
    flex: 1;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    color: var(--slate);
    font-weight: 500;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    border: 1px solid var(--slate);
    border-radius: 8px;
    height: 34px;
    min-height: 34px;
}

/* ===================HERO ==================== */
.hero {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 400px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    min-height: 100vh;
    height: 100vh;
    justify-content: center;
    padding-top: 20vh;
    margin-top: -20vh;
}

.hero-content {
    text-align: center;
    max-width: 600px;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 1rem;
    margin: 0 auto;
}

.hero-title {
    font-size: 4rem;
    font-weight: 900;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    background: var(--accent);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    background-clip: text;
    word-break: break-word;
}

.hero-title::after {
    display: block;
    width: 60px;
    height: 4px;
    background: var(--accent);
    margin: 0.5rem auto 0;
    border-radius: 4px;
}

.hero-features {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin: 3rem 0 1rem 0;
}

.hero-buttons {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row !important;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin-top: 1rem;
    width: 100%;
}

.hero-buttons .btn {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
}

/* ===================FEATURE ==================== */
.feature {
    background: none;
    padding: 1rem;
    border-radius: 16px;
    text-align: center;
    min-width: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.feature i {
    font-size: 2rem;
    color: var(--accent);
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.feature span {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: var(--slate);
    font-weight: 500;
    display: block;
    word-break: keep-all;
    white-space: normal;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    line-height: 1.2;
}

.edit-exercise-item {
    cursor: grab;
    border: 2px dashed transparent;
}

.edit-exercise-item:active { cursor: grabbing; }

.sortable-chosen {
    border-color: var(--accent) !important;
    opacity: 0.8;
}

.sortable-ghost {
    border: 2px dashed var(--accent) !important;
    background: transparent !important;
    opacity: 0.4;
}

/* ===================РЕДАКТИРОВАНИЕ СТРАНИЦ ==================== */
.editing .section-block {
    border: 2px dashed transparent;
    padding: 0.5rem;
}

.editing .section-block:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }
.editing .section-drag { display: flex !important; }

.editing .item-card {
    cursor: grab;
    border: 2px dashed transparent;
}

.editing .item-card:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }
.editing .item-card:active { cursor: grabbing; }

.editing .stat-card {
    cursor: grab;
    border: 2px solid transparent;
}

.editing .stat-card:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }
.editing .stat-card:active { cursor: grabbing; }

.editing .stat-item {
    cursor: grab;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    border-radius: 8px;
}

.editing .stat-item:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }
.editing .stat-item:active { cursor: grabbing; }

.sortable-ghost { opacity: 0.4; }

/* ★ Режим редактирования — карточки можно таскать */
.editing .program-list-card {
    cursor: grab;
    border: 2px dashed transparent;
}

.editing .program-list-card:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }
.editing .program-list-card:active { cursor: grabbing; }

/* ★ Кнопка-мусорка в режиме редактирования */
.program-delete {
    color: var(--danger) !important;
}


/* ===================ТРЕНИРОВКА СЕССИЯ ==================== */
.training-session-container {
    height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    max-width: 500px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 1.2rem 0rem;
    background: var(--light);
}

.session-header {
    padding: 1rem 0 0.5rem;
    text-align: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.session-header h1 {
    font-size: 1.8rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--dark);
    margin: 0;
    word-break: break-word;
}

.session-top {
    flex: 3;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-height: 0;
    position: relative;
}

.session-progress-row { flex-shrink: 0; }

.session-progress {
    display: flex;
    gap: 4px;
    align-items: center;
    height: 6px;
}

.progress-dash {
    flex: 1;
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: var(--light-grey);
}

.progress-dash-active { background: var(--accent); }
.progress-dash-current { background: var(--accent-light); }

.session-bg {
    flex: 1;
    background: var(--light);
    border-radius: 16px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: var(--slate);
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    position: relative;
    min-height: 120px;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.session-bg-text { opacity: 0.6; font-style: italic; }

.session-close-btn {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0rem;
    left: 0rem;
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: none;
    color: var(--slate);
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    z-index: 2;
    background: transparent;
}


.session-bottom {
    flex: 1.5;
    background: var(--white);
    border-radius: 20px 20px 0px 0px;
    padding: 1rem 1rem 4rem;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
    min-height: 0;
    width: 100%;
}

.session-exercise-info { text-align: center; }

.session-exercise-info h2 {
    font-size: 1.3rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--dark);
    margin: 0 0 0.3rem;
    word-break: break-word;
}

.session-exercise-details-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
}

.session-exercise-details-row p {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--dark);
}

.session-edit-btn {
    border: none;
    background: var(--white);
    color: var(--accent);
    font-size: 1em;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.session-controls {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr;
    align-items: center;
}

.session-btn {
    border: none;
    border-radius: 10px;
    font-weight: 500;
    width: 42px;
    height: 42px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    border-bottom: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 80%, black);
}

.session-btn-prev,
.session-btn-next {
    background: var(--accent-light);
    color: var(--dark);
    justify-self: center;
    border-bottom: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-light) 80%, black);
}

.session-btn-prev:disabled,
.session-btn-next:disabled {
    opacity: 0.3;
    cursor: not-allowed;
}

.session-btn-main {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--white);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 0 2rem;
    width: auto;
    height: 40px;
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    grid-column: 2 / 3;
    justify-self: center;
}

/* =================== ПЛАШКА «ЧТО ЗНАЧИТ ЦВЕТ МЫШЦ?» ==================== */
.session-muscles-hint {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0rem;           /* ← отступ от левого края */
    bottom: 0.4rem;
    transform: none;        /* ← убираем центрирование */
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.3rem;
    padding: 0.3rem 0.4rem;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--light-grey);
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--white);
    color: var(--slate);
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    cursor: pointer;
    white-space: nowrap;
    z-index: 10;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

.session-muscles-hint i {
    color: var(--accent);
    font-size: 0.7rem;
}

.session-muscles-hint:active {
    opacity: 0.75;
}

body.theme-dark-mode .session-muscles-hint {
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    border-color: var(--border-color);
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card-dark);
}

/* ── Сжатый вид: только иконка ── */
.session-muscles-hint.compact {

    padding: 0.3rem;
font-size: 0.7rem;
    justify-content: center;
    border-radius: 50%;
}

.session-muscles-hint.compact .muscles-hint-text {
    display: none;
}

/* =================== КАРТИНКА В МОДАЛКЕ «ЦВЕТ МЫШЦ» ==================== */
.muscles-hint-image {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: var(--light);
    border: 1.5px solid var(--light-grey);
    border-radius: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    /* Убрали padding и min-height, чтобы фото задавало размер */
}

.muscles-hint-image img {
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;       /* Сохраняет пропорции картинки */
    display: block;
    border-radius: 10px; /* Немного скругляем углы самой картинки, чтобы вписывалась в рамку */
}

body.theme-dark-mode .muscles-hint-image {
    background: var(--bg-primary);
    border-color: var(--border-color);
}

/* ===================ФИНИШ ТРЕНИРОВКИ ==================== */
.finish-container {
    height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    max-width: 500px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 1.5rem;
    background: var(--light);
}

.finish-content {
    width: 100%;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    background: var(--white);
    border-radius: 24px;
    padding: 1rem;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-float);
}

.finish-title {
    font-size: 1.4rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--dark);
    text-align: center;
    letter-spacing: 0.3px;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.finish-trophy {
    font-size: 5rem;
    color: var(--accent);
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    margin-top: 2rem;
}

.finish-trophy i { display: block; }

.finish-stats {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    width: 100%;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.finish-stat-item {
    background: var(--light);
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 0.8rem 0.3rem;
    text-align: center;
    min-height: 70px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid var(--light-grey);
}

.finish-stat-label {
    display: block;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--slate);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.3px;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.finish-stat-value {
    display: block;
    font-size: 1.3rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--dark);
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    max-width: 100%;
}

.finish-btn { width: 100%; }

/* =================== НИЖНЯЯ НАВИГАЦИЯ (APPLE LIQUID GLASS) ==================== */
.bottom-nav {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: clamp(12px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px), 20px);
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    width: 280px;
    height: 60px;
    padding: 5px;
    border-radius: 30px;
    z-index: 1000;

    /* ★ НОВОЕ: плавная анимация скрытия/появления ★ */
    transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);

    background: linear-gradient(
        180deg,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5) 0%,
        rgba(241, 245, 249, 0.45) 50%,
        rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.4) 100%
    );
    backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(200%);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(200%);
    box-shadow:
        0 12px 40px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.14),
        0 4px 12px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08),
        0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06),
        0 4px 24px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent),
        inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2),
        inset 0 -1px 1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06),
        0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
    border: none;
    overflow: hidden;
    touch-action: manipulation;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

/* ★ Скрытое состояние — меню уезжает вниз за пределы экрана ★ */
.bottom-nav.bottom-nav-hidden {
    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(calc(100% + 40px));
}

.nav-bubble {
    position: absolute;
    top: 5px;
    left: 0;
    height: 50px;
    width: 72px;
    border-radius: 25px;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28);
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(200%);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(200%);
    box-shadow:
        0 6px 18px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05),
        0 2px 6px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05),
        0 4px 20px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 15%, transparent),
        inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9),
        inset 0 -1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04),
        inset 0 0 0 0.5px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 1;
    will-change: transform, width;
    transform: translateX(5px);
    transition:
        transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
        width 0.42s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
        background 0.25s ease,
        box-shadow 0.25s ease;
}

.nav-items {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    display: flex;
    height: 100%;
    width: 100%;
    align-items: center;
}

.nav-item {
    flex: 1;
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    color: #94A3B8;
    font-size: 22px;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

.nav-item i {
    font-size: 22px;
    pointer-events: none;
    transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
}

/* Цвет иконки и её масштаб теперь зависят от положения пузырька, а не от nav-item-active */
.nav-item i {
    font-size: 22px;
    pointer-events: none;
    transition: color 0.25s ease,
                transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
    color: #94A3B8;
}

/* Иконка, которая сейчас находится под пузырьком */
.nav-item i.icon-under-bubble {
    color: var(--accent);
    transform: scale(1.08);
    filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent));
}

/* Класс nav-item-active больше не даёт цвет — оставляем только для семантики */
.nav-item-active { color: inherit; }

/* Тёмная тема */
body.theme-dark-mode .nav-item i { color: var(--border-color); }
body.theme-dark-mode .nav-item i.icon-under-bubble { color: var(--accent); }

body.theme-dark-mode .bottom-nav {
    background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.5);
    box-shadow:
        0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4),
        0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2),
        inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08),
        inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2),
        0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .nav-bubble {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    box-shadow:
        0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3),
        inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
}


body.theme-dark-mode .nav-item { color: var(--border-color); }
body.theme-dark-mode .nav-item-active { color: var(--accent); }

/* ===================УВЕДОМЛЕНИЯ ==================== */
#notificationContainer {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    z-index: 9999;
    padding: 0.8rem 1rem;
    pointer-events: none;
    padding-top: calc(0.8rem + env(safe-area-inset-top, 12px));
    display: block !important;
}

#notificationCard {
    max-width: 500px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    pointer-events: auto;
    background: var(--white);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 0.8rem 0.8rem;
    border: 2px solid var(--accent);
    transform: translateY(-120px);
    opacity: 0;
    transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), opacity 0.3s ease;
}

#notificationCard.show {
    transform: translateY(0);
    opacity: 1;
}

.notification-content {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    min-height: 34px;
}

.notification-icon {
    font-size: 1.6rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    line-height: 1;
}

.notification-body {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
}

.notification-text {
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
    color: var(--dark);
    font-weight: 500;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
}

.notification-ok-btn {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--white);
    border: none;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 0.3rem 1.2rem;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    cursor: pointer;
    white-space: nowrap;
    height: 34px;
    line-height: 1;
    display: inline-block;
}

/* ===================TOAST ==================== */
#toast {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: calc(70px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, 20px) scale(0.9);
    background: var(--bg-primary);
    color: #fff;
    padding: 0.7rem 1rem;
    border-radius: 14px;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    z-index: 3000;
    max-width: 90%;
    text-align: center;
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;

    box-shadow:
        0 8px 24px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.25),
        0 2px 6px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.15);

    /* переход для СКРЫТИЯ (по умолчанию) */
    transition:
        opacity 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1),
        transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1);

    will-change: opacity, transform;
}

/* ПОЯВЛЕНИЕ — пружинный эффект */
#toast.show {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translate(-50%, 0) scale(1);
    transition:
        opacity 0.28s ease,
        transform 0.38s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
}

/* ★★★ АНИМАЦИЯ ИСЧЕЗНОВЕНИЯ ★★★ */
#toast.hiding {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translate(-50%, -10px) scale(0.95);
    transition:
        opacity 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1),
        transform 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1);
}

/* Тёмная тема */
body.theme-dark-mode #toast {
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    color: var(--text-primary);
    box-shadow:
        0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5),
        0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35),
        inset 0 0 0 1px var(--border-color);
}

/* ===================ТУТОРИАЛ ==================== */
.tutorial-overlay {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);
    z-index: 9999;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    pointer-events: none;
    transition: background 0.5s ease;
}

.tutorial-overlay-active {
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
    pointer-events: auto;
}

.tutorial-tooltip {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 50px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(50px);
    background: var(--white);
    color: var(--dark);
    padding: 1rem;
    max-width: 500px;
    width: 90%;
    border-radius: 16px;
    text-align: center;
    z-index: 10001;
    box-shadow: 0 0 30px var(--accent), inset 0 0 0 2px var(--accent);
    opacity: 0;
    transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), 
                opacity 0.4s ease;
    pointer-events: none;
}

body.theme-dark-mode .tutorial-tooltip {
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
}

.tutorial-tooltip-active {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
    pointer-events: auto;
}

.tutorial-dots {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.3rem;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
    width: 100%;
}

.tutorial-dot {
    flex: 1;
    height: 6px;
    border-radius: 16px;
    background: var(--slate);
    opacity: 0.4;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.tutorial-dot-active {
    opacity: 1;
    background: var(--accent);
}

.tutorial-text {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    color: var(--dark);
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.5;
    white-space: pre-wrap;
}

body.theme-dark-mode .tutorial-text {
    color: var(--text-primary);
}

.tutorial-buttons {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 100%;
}

.tutorial-buttons .btn {
    padding: 0.6rem 2rem;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 140px;
    display: block;
    border-radius: 12px;
}

.tutorial-highlight {
    position: relative !important;
    z-index: 10000 !important;
    overflow: visible !important;
    border: 3px solid transparent !important;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(220, 20, 60, 0) !important;
    background: var(--white) !important;
    color: var(--accent) !important;
    transition: border-color 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), 
                box-shadow 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) !important;
    will-change: border-color, box-shadow;
}

body.theme-dark-mode .tutorial-highlight {
    background: var(--bg-secondary) !important;
    color: var(--accent) !important;
}

.tutorial-highlight-active {
    border-color: var(--accent) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 0 30px var(--accent) !important;
}

.tutorial-highlight .tab-btn {
    background: var(--white) !important;
    color: var(--accent) !important;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card) !important;
}

.tutorial-highlight .tab-btn-active {
    box-shadow: 0 0 30px var(--accent), var(--shadow-card) !important;
}

.tutorial-highlight#editStatsBtn,
.tutorial-highlight#actionButton,
.tutorial-highlight#editWorkoutBtn,
.tutorial-highlight .custom-workout .btn-primary {
    background: var(--white) !important;
    color: var(--accent) !important;
}

body.theme-dark-mode .tutorial-highlight#editStatsBtn,
body.theme-dark-mode .tutorial-highlight#actionButton,
body.theme-dark-mode .tutorial-highlight#editWorkoutBtn,
body.theme-dark-mode .tutorial-highlight .custom-workout .btn-primary {
    background: var(--bg-secondary) !important;
    color: var(--accent) !important;
}

.tutorial-highlight#editStatsBtn i,
.tutorial-highlight#actionButton i,
.tutorial-highlight#editWorkoutBtn i,
.tutorial-highlight .custom-workout .btn-primary i {
    color: var(--accent) !important;
}

.tutorial-parent-visible,
.tutorial-parent-visible .section-body,
.tutorial-parent-visible .section-block,
.tutorial-parent-visible .scroll-wrapper,
.tutorial-parent-visible .dashboard-container,
.tutorial-parent-visible .profile-container,
.tutorial-parent-visible .item-grid,
.tutorial-parent-visible .tab-content,
.tutorial-parent-visible .tab-content-active {
    overflow: visible !important;
}

/* =================== PREMIUM МОДАЛКА =================== */
