.premium-modal .premium-content {
    max-width: 480px;
    width: 95%;
    padding: 1rem;
    background: var(--white);
    border-radius: 24px;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-float);
}

.premium-header {
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.premium-icon {
    font-size: 3rem;
    color: var(--gold);
}

.premium-icon i { color: var(--gold); }

.premium-title {
    font-size: 1.4rem;
    font-weight: 800;
    color: var(--accent);
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.premium-table {
    width: 100%;
    border-radius: 14px;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid var(--light-grey);
    margin: 0.5rem 0;
}

.premium-table-header {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 0.8fr 0.8fr;
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--white);
    border: 1px solid var(--accent);
}

.premium-table-header .premium-table-cell {
    padding: 0.4rem 0.5rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    text-align: center;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.premium-table-header .premium-table-cell-left { text-align: left; }

.premium-table-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 0.8fr 0.8fr;
    background: var(--white);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--light-grey);
}

.premium-table-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

.premium-table-cell {
    padding: 0.4rem 0.5rem;
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    text-align: center;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.premium-table-cell-left { font-weight: 600; text-align: left; }
.premium-table-cell-center { font-size: 0.6rem; }

.premium-table-cell-premium {
    font-weight: 700;
    border-radius: 0;
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--white);
}

.premium-table-cell-highlight {
    color: var(--accent);
    font-weight: 600;
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 5%, transparent);
}

.premium-prices {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

/* =================== PREMIUM: КАРТОЧКИ ТАРИФОВ ==================== */
.premium-price-card {
    position: relative;
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 0.5rem;
    text-align: center;
    background: var(--light);
    border: 1px solid var(--light-grey);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
}

.premium-price-card-active {
    border: 2px solid var(--accent);
    background: var(--accent-light);
}

/* ★ Плашка -10% на годовом тарифе */
.premium-price-discount {
    position: absolute;
    top: -8px;
    right: -4px;
    background: var(--gold);
    color: #0F172A;
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
    border-radius: 6px;
    letter-spacing: 0.3px;
    z-index: 2;
}

.premium-price-label {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: var(--dark);
    font-weight: 700;
}

.premium-price-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.1rem;
}

.premium-price-value {
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    font-weight: 800;
    color: var(--dark);
}


.premium-price-period { font-size: 0.6rem; color: var(--slate); }

.premium-buttons { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; }
.premium-buttons .btn { flex: 1; }

body.theme-dark-mode .premium-modal .premium-content { background: var(--bg-secondary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .premium-table { border: 1px solid var(--border-color); }
body.theme-dark-mode .premium-table-row { border: 1px solid var(--border-color); background: var(--bg-secondary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .premium-table-cell-left { color: var(--text-primary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .premium-table-cell-center { color: var(--text-primary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .premium-table-cell-highlight {
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-dark) 50%, transparent);
    color: var(--accent);
}
body.theme-dark-mode .premium-table-header .premium-table-cell { color: var(--light-grey); }
body.theme-dark-mode .premium-price-label { color: var(--text-primary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .premium-price-card-monthly { background: var(--bg-primary); border-color: var(--border-color); }
body.theme-dark-mode .premium-price-card-yearly { background: var(--bg-primary); border-color: var(--border-color); }
body.theme-dark-mode .premium-price-value { color: var(--text-primary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .premium-price-period { color: var(--text-secondary); }

body.theme-dark-mode .premium-price-card {
    background: var(--bg-primary);
    border: 1px solid var(--border-color);

}

body.theme-dark-mode .premium-price-card-active {
    background: var(--accent-dark);
    border-color: var(--accent);
}

/* ===================АДАПТАЦИЯ ==================== */
@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .dashboard-container,
    .profile-container { padding: 1rem 1rem 90px; }
    .dashboard-title { font-size: 1.5rem; }
    .item-card { padding: 0.5rem; }
    .item-icon { width: 44px; height: 44px; min-width: 44px; }
    .item-icon img { width: 28px; height: 28px; }
    .exercise-status { width: 44px; height: 44px; min-width: 44px; }
    .exercise-number { font-size: 1rem; }
    .exercise-check { width: 26px; height: 26px; font-size: 1rem; }
    .edit-exercise-icon { width: 24px; height: 24px; }
    .stats-summary { gap: 0.5rem; }
    .stat-card { padding: 0.8rem 0.5rem; }
    .stat-label { font-size: 0.7rem; }
    .calendar-day { font-size: 0.8rem; padding: 0.4rem 0; }
    .nav-item i { font-size: 18px; }
    .scroll-wrapper { max-height: 380px; }
    .hero-features { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 0.5rem; }
    .feature { padding: 0.8rem 0.3rem; }
    .feature i { font-size: 1.5rem; }
    .feature span { font-size: 0.7rem; }
    .finish-content { padding: 2rem 1rem 1.2rem; }
    .finish-stat-item { min-height: 60px; padding: 0.6rem 0.2rem; }
    .finish-stat-label { font-size: 0.6rem; }
    .finish-stat-value { font-size: 1rem; }
    .finish-stars i { font-size: 1.6rem; }
    .friends-list-block { padding: 0.8rem; }
    .search-btn { font-size: 0.7rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.8rem; }
    .exercise-search-block .search-btn { font-size: 0.7rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.8rem; }
    .exercise-search-block .icon-option { width: 38px; height: 38px; }
    .exercise-search-block .icon-option img { width: 22px; height: 22px; }
    .notification-text { font-size: 0.8rem; }
    .notification-icon { font-size: 1.3rem; }
    .notification-ok-btn { font-size: 0.7rem; padding: 0.2rem 0.8rem; height: 30px; }
    .auth-title { font-size: 3rem; }
}

@media (max-width: 380px) {
    .finish-stat-item { min-height: 55px; padding: 0.4rem 0.15rem; }
    .finish-stat-label { font-size: 0.55rem; }
    .finish-stat-value { font-size: 0.85rem; }
    .finish-stars i { font-size: 1.4rem; }
    .finish-trophy { font-size: 4rem; margin-bottom: 2rem; margin-top: 2rem; }
    .notification-text { font-size: 0.7rem; }
    .notification-icon { font-size: 1.1rem; }
    .notification-ok-btn { font-size: 0.65rem; padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem; height: 28px; }
}

@media (max-width: 320px) {
    .finish-stat-item { min-height: 50px; padding: 0.3rem 0.1rem; }
    .finish-stat-label { font-size: 0.5rem; }
    .finish-stat-value { font-size: 0.75rem; }
    .finish-stars i { font-size: 1.2rem; }
}

@media (max-height: 600px) {
    #page-hero .hero,
    #page-loading .hero { padding: 0.5rem; }
    #page-hero .hero-content,
    #page-loading .hero-content { padding: 0.5rem; }
}

/* ===================ВСПОМОГАТЕЛЬНЫЕ КЛАССЫ ==================== */
::placeholder {font-style: italic;}

input.error,
textarea.error {
    border-color: var(--danger) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1) !important;
}

.custom-workout { margin-bottom: 0.5rem; margin-top: 0.5rem; }

.edit-header-block {
    background: var(--light);
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
    margin-top: 1rem;
}

.edit-header-block .form-group { margin-bottom: 1rem; }
.edit-header-block .form-group:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

.edit-header-block .form-input {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 0.7rem 1rem;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--light-grey);
    border-radius: 10px;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    background: #FAFCFF;
    color: #0F172A;
}

.edit-header-block .form-input:focus {
    outline: none;
    border-color: var(--accent);
}

.edit-header-block .icon-picker {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin-top: 0.3rem;
}

.edit-header-block .icon-option {
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    border: 2px solid var(--light-grey);
    background: var(--light);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0.3rem;
}

.edit-header-block .icon-option-active {
    border-color: var(--accent);
}
.edit-header-block .icon-option img {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    object-fit: contain;
}

.category-filter-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
}

/* =================== ПРАВИЛА (ГАЛОЧКИ) =================== */
.rules-list {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    background: var(--light);
    padding: 0.5rem;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border:1px solid var(--light-grey);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .rules-list { border:1px solid var(--border-color); }

.rule-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: var(--dark);
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0.2rem 0.4rem;
    border-radius: 8px;
    transition: background 0.2s ease;
    user-select: none;
}

.rule-checkbox {
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    appearance: none;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    border: 2px solid var(--slate);
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: var(--white);
    cursor: pointer;
    position: relative;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
    pointer-events: auto;
}

.rule-checkbox:checked {
    background: var(--accent);
    border-color: var(--accent);
}

.rule-checkbox:checked::after {
    content: '✓';
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    color: var(--white);
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
}

/* =================== ВЫБОР ТЕМЫ (МОДАЛКА) ==================== */
.theme-options-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.theme-option {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.5rem 1rem 0.5rem 0.5rem;
    background: var(--light);
    border-radius: 12px;
    cursor: pointer;
    border: 2px solid transparent;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.theme-option-active { border-color: var(--accent); }

.theme-option-icon {
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: none;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.theme-option-icon i { font-size: 1.5rem; }
.theme-option-icon .fa-sun { color: var(--gold); }

.theme-option-info { flex: 1; text-align: left; }

.theme-option-check {
    width: 24px;
    height: 24px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--accent);
    color: white;
    display: none;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.theme-option-check i { font-size: 0.8rem; }

.theme-option-iconDark {
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: none;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.theme-option-iconSistem {
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: none;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.settings-titleDark {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--text-primary);
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.settings-descDark {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.theme-option-iconDark i { font-size: 1.5rem; }
.theme-option-iconDark .fa-moon { color: var(--gold); }

.theme-option-iconSistem i { font-size: 1.5rem; }
.theme-option-iconSistem .fa-cloud-sun-rain { color: var(--slate); }

.theme-option-active .theme-option-check { display: flex !important; }

.auth-card .form-label {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--dark);
    margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
}

/* =================== НОЧНАЯ ТЕМА ==================== */
body.theme-dark-mode {
    --bg-primary: #0F172A;
    --bg-secondary: #1E293B;
    --text-primary: #94A3B8;
    --text-secondary: #64748B;
    --border-color: #334155;
    --shadow-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
}

body.theme-dark-mode {
    background: var(--bg-primary) !important;
    color: var(--text-primary) !important;
}

body.theme-dark-mode .dashboard-container,
body.theme-dark-mode .profile-container { background: transparent; }

body.theme-dark-mode .section-block,
body.theme-dark-mode .section-blockFriend { background: var(--bg-primary); }

body.theme-dark-mode .item-card,
body.theme-dark-mode .exercise-item,
body.theme-dark-mode .edit-exercise-item,
body.theme-dark-mode .stat-card,
body.theme-dark-mode .history-item,
body.theme-dark-mode .friend-item,
body.theme-dark-mode .friend-itemMOD,
body.theme-dark-mode .friend-request-item,
body.theme-dark-mode .friend-result-item {
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card-dark);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .friend-itemMOD { border: 1.5px solid var(--border-color); }

body.theme-dark-mode .history-item-title { color: var(--text-primary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .history-item-details { color: var(--text-secondary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .history-item-date { color: var(--text-secondary); }

body.theme-dark-mode .item-icon { background: var(--accent-dark); }
body.theme-dark-mode .item-icon img { filter: brightness(0.9); }

body.theme-dark-mode .item-icon .item-number,
body.theme-dark-mode .item-icon span { color: var(--accent); }

body.theme-dark-mode .icon-option {
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    border-color: var(--border-color);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .icon-option-active { border-color: var(--accent); }
body.theme-dark-mode .icon-option img { filter: brightness(0.9); }

body.theme-dark-mode .edit-exercise-item .item-icon { background: var(--bg-secondary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .edit-exercise-item .item-icon img { filter: brightness(0.9); }

body.theme-dark-mode .form-label { color: var(--text-primary); }

body.theme-dark-mode .exercise-status { background: var(--accent-dark); }
body.theme-dark-mode .exercise-number { color: var(--accent); }

body.theme-dark-mode .exercise-check {
    border-color: var(--border-color);
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .exercise-check.completed {
    background: var(--accent);
    border-color: var(--accent);
    color: var(--text-primary);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .item-icon { background: var(--accent-dark); }

body.theme-dark-mode .dashboard-title,
body.theme-dark-mode .section-title,
body.theme-dark-mode .item-title,
body.theme-dark-mode .exercise-name,
body.theme-dark-mode .edit-exercise-name,
body.theme-dark-mode .settings-title,
body.theme-dark-mode .profile-name,
body.theme-dark-mode .modal-title,
body.theme-dark-mode .finish-title,
body.theme-dark-mode .level-title { color: var(--text-primary) !important; }

body.theme-dark-mode .item-desc,
body.theme-dark-mode .exercise-details,
body.theme-dark-mode .edit-exercise-details,
body.theme-dark-mode .settings-desc,
body.theme-dark-mode .modal-text,
body.theme-dark-mode .finish-stat-label,
body.theme-dark-mode .calendar-weekday,
body.theme-dark-mode .auth-switch { color: var(--text-secondary); }

body.theme-dark-mode .stat-number,
body.theme-dark-mode .finish-stat-value { color: var(--text-primary); }

body.theme-dark-mode .form-input,
body.theme-dark-mode .search-input {
    background: var(--bg-primary);
    color: var(--text-primary);
    border-color: var(--border-color);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .form-input:focus,
body.theme-dark-mode .search-input:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }

body.theme-dark-mode .form-input::placeholder,
body.theme-dark-mode .search-input::placeholder { color: var(--border-color); }

body.theme-dark-mode .item-card.current-user { border-color: var(--accent); }
body.theme-dark-mode .empty-state { 
    background: var(--bg-secondary); 
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card-dark);
}
body.theme-dark-mode .empty-title { color: var(--text-primary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .empty-text { color: var(--text-secondary); }

body.theme-dark-mode .progress-dash { background: var(--bg-secondary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .progress-dash-current { background: var(--accent-dark); }
body.theme-dark-mode .progress-dash-active { background: var(--accent); }

body.theme-dark-mode .session-edit-btn {
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    color: var(--accent);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .session-btn-prev,
body.theme-dark-mode .session-btn-next {
    background: var(--accent-dark);
    color: var(--light);
    border-bottom: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-dark) 80%, black);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .finish-container { background: var(--bg-primary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .toggle-group { background: var(--bg-primary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .toggle-btn { color: var(--slate); }
body.theme-dark-mode .toggle-btn:active { opacity: 0.7; }
body.theme-dark-mode .toggle-btn-active {
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    color: var(--accent);
}
body.theme-dark-mode .edit-header-block { background: var(--bg-primary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .section-toggle { color: var(--text-primary); }

body.theme-dark-mode .tabs { background: var(--bg-); }
body.theme-dark-mode .tab-btn { color: var(--text-secondary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .tab-btn-active {
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    color: var(--accent);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .modal-content { background: var(--bg-secondary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .modal-overlay { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7); }

body.theme-dark-mode .section-header .section-title { color: var(--text-primary); }

body.theme-dark-mode .profile-card { background: var(--bg-secondary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .profile-info {
    background: var(--bg-primary);
    color: var(--text-secondary);
}
body.theme-dark-mode .profile-info strong { color: var(--text-primary); }

body.theme-dark-mode .level-block { background: var(--bg-primary); }

body.theme-dark-mode .level-lvl,
body.theme-dark-mode .level-progress-text { color: var(--text-secondary); }

body.theme-dark-mode .level-bar { background: var(--bg-secondary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .color-btn { border: 3px solid var(--bg-primary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .color-btn-active { border-color: var(--light); }

body.theme-dark-mode .friend-result-item .friend-avatar { background: var(--accent-dark); }
body.theme-dark-mode .friend-result-item { border: 1px solid var(--bg-primary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .friend-result-item .friend-result-info strong { color: var(--text-primary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .friend-result-item .friend-result-info span { color: var(--text-secondary); }

body.theme-dark-mode .friend-request-item .friend-avatar { background: var(--accent-dark); }
body.theme-dark-mode .friend-request-item .friend-result-info strong { color: var(--text-primary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .friend-request-item .friend-result-info span { color: var(--text-secondary); }

body.theme-dark-mode .friend-avatar { background: var(--accent-dark); }
body.theme-dark-mode .friend-info strong { color: var(--text-primary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .friend-info span { color: var(--text-secondary); }

body.theme-dark-mode .item-icon { background: var(--accent-dark) !important; }

body.theme-dark-mode .calendar-container { background: var(--bg-secondary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .calendar-day { color: var(--text-primary); }

body.theme-dark-mode .calendar-day-has-workout-1 {
    background: var(--accent-dark);
    color: var(--text-primary);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .calendar-day-has-workout-2 {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--white);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .calendar-legend { background: var(--bg-secondary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .legend-item { color: var(--text-secondary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .legend-box-today { background: var(--bg-secondary); }

body.theme-dark-mode .stats-summaryMOD {
    background: var(--bg-primary);
    border: 1.5px solid var(--border-color);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .stats-summaryMOD .stat-card { background: var(--bg-secondary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .stat-item { background: var(--bg-secondary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .stat-name { color: var(--text-primary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .stat-bar { background: var(--border-color); }

body.theme-dark-mode .settings-block { background: var(--bg-secondary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .settings-item { border-bottom-color: var(--border-color) !important; }
body.theme-dark-mode .settings-icon { background: var(--accent-dark); }
body.theme-dark-mode .settings-icon-danger {
    background: #4A0616 !important;
    color: #EF4444 !important;
}

body.theme-dark-mode .friends-list-block { 
    background: var(--bg-secondary); 
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card-dark);
}

body.theme-dark-mode #notificationCard {
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-float-dark);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .notification-text { color: var(--text-primary); }

body.theme-dark-mode .auth-title {
    background: var(--accent);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    background-clip: text;
}

body.theme-dark-mode .training-session-container { background: var(--bg-primary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .session-bottom { background: var(--bg-secondary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .session-exercise-info h2 { color: var(--text-primary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .session-exercise-details-row p { color: var(--text-secondary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .session-bg { background: var(--bg-primary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .session-timer { color: var(--text-primary); }

body.theme-dark-mode .finish-content { background: var(--bg-secondary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .finish-stat-item {
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    border-color: var(--border-color);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .rules-list { background: var(--bg-secondary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .rule-item { color: var(--text-primary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .rule-checkbox {
    background: var(--bg-primary);
    border-color: var(--border-color);
}
body.theme-dark-mode .rule-checkbox:checked {
    background: var(--accent);
    border-color: var(--accent);
}

body.theme-dark-mode ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; height: 6px; }
body.theme-dark-mode ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--bg-secondary); }
body.theme-dark-mode ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: var(--border-color);
    border-radius: 4px;
}

/* =================== СТРАНИЦЫ РЕГИСТРАЦИИ И ВХОДА В ТЁМНОЙ ТЕМЕ ==================== */
body.theme-dark-mode #page-register,
body.theme-dark-mode #page-register-email,
body.theme-dark-mode #page-register-password,
body.theme-dark-mode #page-register-verify,
body.theme-dark-mode #page-login,
body.theme-dark-mode #page-login-password { background: var(--bg-primary) !important; }

body.theme-dark-mode .auth-container { background: var(--bg-primary); }

body.theme-dark-mode .auth-title {
    background: var(--accent);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    background-clip: text;
}

body.theme-dark-mode .form-label-large { color: var(--text-primary); }

body.theme-dark-mode .form-input {
    background: var(--bg-primary);
    color: var(--text-primary);
    border-color: var(--border-color);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .form-input:focus {
    border-color: var(--accent);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .form-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-secondary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .form-label { color: var(--text-primary); }

body.theme-dark-mode .auth-switch { color: var(--text-secondary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .auth-switch a { color: var(--text-primary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .auth-switch a:hover { color: var(--accent); }

body.theme-dark-mode #page-register-verify p { color: var(--text-secondary) !important; }
body.theme-dark-mode #page-register-verify .auth-card p:first-of-type { color: var(--text-primary) !important; }
body.theme-dark-mode #page-register-verify div[style*="font-size: 3rem"] { filter: brightness(0.9); }

body.theme-dark-mode .form-input.error {
    border-color: var(--danger);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .btn-primary {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--light-grey);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .btn-secondary {
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--accent);
    border: 2px solid var(--accent);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .btn-danger {
    background: var(--danger);
    color: var(--light-grey);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .hero-title {
    background: var(--accent);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    background-clip: text;
}

body.theme-dark-mode .feature span { color: var(--text-secondary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .hero-buttons .btn { background: var(--accent); color: var(--white); }
body.theme-dark-mode .settings-action { color: var(--border-color); }
body.theme-dark-mode .item-action { color: var(--border-color); }
body.theme-dark-mode .task-checkbox .fa-square-check { color: var(--accent) !important; }
body.theme-dark-mode .task-checkbox .fa-square { color: var(--border-color) !important; }
body.theme-dark-mode .settings-item-task .fa-square-check { color: var(--accent) !important; }
body.theme-dark-mode .settings-item-task .fa-square { color: var(--border-color) !important; }

body.theme-dark-mode #page-loading .hero-title {
    background: var(--accent);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    background-clip: text;
}

body.theme-dark-mode .achievement-icon.locked { color: var(--bg-secondary) !important; }
body.theme-dark-mode .achievement-icon.unlocked { color: var(--gold) !important; }
body.theme-dark-mode .achievement-icon-top.unlocked { color: var(--gold) !important; }
body.theme-dark-mode .achievement-icon-top.locked { color: var(--border-color) !important; }

body.theme-dark-mode .achievement-modal-item { border-bottom-color: var(--border-color); }
body.theme-dark-mode .achievement-modal-name { color: var(--text-primary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .achievement-modal-desc { color: var(--text-secondary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .achievement-modal-progress-text.locked { color: var(--text-primary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .achievement-modal-progress-text.unlocked { color: var(--text-primary); }

/* =================== ТАЙМЕР ОТДЫХА ==================== */
.session-rest-timer {
    font-size: 5rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--accent);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    text-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(220, 20, 60, 0.15);
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
}

.session-rest-timer-small { font-size: 1.2rem; }

@keyframes restPulse {
    0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); }
    50% { transform: scale(1.02); }
}

.session-rest-timer { animation: restPulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; }

/* =================== ДОСТИЖЕНИЯ ==================== */
.achievements-container {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    flex-wrap: nowrap;
    margin-top: 0.8rem;
    gap: 0;
    overflow: visible;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 0 1rem;      /* ← отступы слева и справа */
    box-sizing: border-box; /* ← чтобы padding не расширял контейнер */
}

.achievements-container.hidden { display: none !important; }

.achievement-icon {
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 1.2rem;
}

/* =================== ДОСТИЖЕНИЯ В РЕЙТИНГАХ ==================== */
.achievement-icon-top {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
    margin-right: 0px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.achievement-icon-top.unlocked { color: var(--gold) !important; }
.achievement-icon-top.locked { color: var(--light-grey) !important; }
.achievement-icon.unlocked { color: var(--gold) !important; }
.achievement-icon.locked { color: var(--light-grey) !important; }

/* =================== ДОСТИЖЕНИЯ В МОДАЛКЕ ==================== */
.achievement-modal-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.2rem;
    padding: 0.5rem 0rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--light-grey);
}

.achievement-modal-item:last-child {
    border-bottom: none;
    padding: 0.5rem 0rem 0rem 0rem;
}

.achievement-modal-icon {
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.achievement-modal-icon.unlocked { color: var(--accent); background-color: none; }
.achievement-modal-icon.locked { color: var(--accent); background-color: none; }

.achievement-modal-info { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

.achievement-modal-name {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--dark);
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.achievement-modal-desc {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: var(--slate);
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.achievement-modal-progress {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.achievement-modal-progress-text {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-align: center;
}

.achievement-modal-progress-text.unlocked { color: var(--slate); }
.achievement-modal-progress-text.locked { color: var(--slate); }

/* =================== PREMIUM ЛОКИРОВКА В КАТАЛОГЕ ==================== */
.item-card.premium-locked {
    cursor: pointer;
    border-color: var(--gold);
}

/* ★ Плашка PREMIUM */
.premium-badge {
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    color: var(--gold);
    font-weight: 700;
    padding: 0.2rem 0.4rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--gold);
    border-radius: 4px;
    white-space: nowrap;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* ★ Уменьшенный размер иконки для списка упражнений */
.exercise-list-card .item-icon {
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    min-width: 44px;
}

.exercise-list-card .item-icon img {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
}

/* ── Эмодзи-иконка в фильтре («Все») ── */
.icon-option-emoji {
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    line-height: 1;
}

/* ── Премиум-категории в фильтре ── */
.icon-option-premium {
    position: relative;
}

/* =================== ВРЕМЯ ОТДЫХА ==================== */
.rest-time-picker {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.rest-time-btn {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 44px;
    padding: 0.4rem 0.2rem;
    border: 2px solid var(--light-grey);
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: var(--white);
    color: var(--slate);
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.rest-time-active {
    border-color: var(--accent-light);
    color: var(--accent);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .rest-time-btn {
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    border-color: var(--border-color);
    color: var(--text-secondary);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .rest-time-active {
    border-color: var(--accent-dark);
    color: var(--accent);
}

/* =================== КНОПКИ УПРАВЛЕНИЯ ОТДЫХОМ ==================== */
.session-rest-control-btn {
    background: var(--white);
    border: 2px solid var(--light-grey);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 0.4rem;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--slate);
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    flex: 1;
    justify-content: center;
}

.session-rest-control-btn i { font-size: 0.7rem; }

#sessionRestControls { display: none !important; }
#sessionRestControls.visible { display: flex !important; }

body.theme-dark-mode .session-rest-control-btn {
    background: var(--bg-primary);
    border-color: var(--border-color);
}

/* =================== ВЕС В СЕССИИ ==================== */
.weight-btn {
    background: var(--light);
    border: 1px solid var(--light-grey);
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--slate);
    cursor: pointer;
}

.weight-text {
    min-width: 50px;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--dark);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .weight-btn {
    background: var(--bg-primary);
    border-color: var(--border-color);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .weight-text { color: var(--text-primary); }

/* =================== ТАЙМЕР УПРАЖНЕНИЯ ==================== */
#sessionExerciseTimerWrapper {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 0rem;
    right: 0.5rem;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.2rem;
    z-index: 2;
    background: none;
    text-align: center;
}

#sessionExerciseTimer {
    font-size: 3rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--accent);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}

#sessionSetCounter {
    display: none;
    font-size: 1.4rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--accent);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    align-self: flex-end;
    padding-bottom: 0.65rem;
}

body.theme-dark-mode #sessionExerciseTimerWrapper { background: none; }
body.theme-dark-mode #sessionExerciseTimer { background: none; color: var(--accent); }
body.theme-dark-mode #sessionSetCounter { background: none; color: var(--accent); }

.calendar-day { cursor: pointer; }
.calendar-day:active { opacity: 0.7; }

#dayWorkoutsList::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; width: 0; height: 0; }

.dayWorkoutsList {
    max-height:40vh;
    overflow-y:auto;
    text-align:left;
    padding:0.5rem;
    background:var(--light);
    border-radius:8px;
    scrollbar-width:none;
    -ms-overflow-style:none;
}

body.theme-dark-mode .dayWorkoutsList { background:var(--bg-primary); }

/* =================== НАГРУЗОЧНЫЙ ИНДЕКС ==================== */
.weekly-load {
    background: var(--white);
    padding: 0.5rem;
    border-radius: 16px;
}

.weekly-load-naw {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.weekly-load-naw-title {
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    color: var(--dark);
}

.weekly-load-Chart {
    background: var(--light);
    border: 1px solid var(--light-grey);
    border-radius: 12px;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.weekly-load-value {
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--accent);
}

.weekly-load-bar {
    width: 100%;
    background: var(--accent-light);
    border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
    position: relative;
    border: 1px solid var(--accent);
    border-bottom: none;
    min-height: 4px;
}

.weekly-load-fill {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    background: var(--accent);
    border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0;
    transition: height 0.3s ease;
}

.weekly-load-label {
    font-size: 0.5rem;
    color: var(--slate);
    text-align: center;
    line-height: 1.2;
}

.weekly-load-info {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    margin-top: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.3rem 1rem;
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    color: var(--slate);
    background: var(--white);
    border-radius: 8px;
    border: 1px solid var(--light-grey);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .weekly-load { background: var(--bg-secondary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .weekly-load-Chart {
    background: var(--bg-primary);
    border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}
body.theme-dark-mode .weekly-load-naw-title { color: var(--text-primary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .weekly-load-info {
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    border-color: var(--border-color);
}
body.theme-dark-mode .weekly-load-bar {
    background: var(--accent-dark);
    border-color: var(--accent);
}
body.theme-dark-mode .weekly-load-value { color: var(--accent); }

/* ===================ЕДИНЫЙ СТИЛЬ ДЛЯ ПЕРЕКЛЮЧАТЕЛЕЙ (TOGGLE) ==================== */
.toggle-group {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    background: var(--light);
    padding: 0.2rem;
    border-radius: 10px;
}

.toggle-btn {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 0.4rem 0.8rem;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 6px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--slate);
}

.toggle-btn-active {
    background: var(--white) !important;
    color: var(--slate) !important;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
}

.theme-dark-mode .toggle-btn-active { background: var(--bg-secondary) !important; }

/* =================== ЗАДАНИЯ (КУРСОР) ==================== */
.settings-item .task-checkbox { cursor: pointer !important; }
.settings-item .task-checkbox i { pointer-events: none; }

/* ===== КНОПКА ВЫБОРА ДРУГА В ИСТОРИИ ===== */
.btn-sm {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    padding: 0.3rem 0.8rem;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--white);
    cursor: pointer;
    font-weight: 500;
}

.btn-sm i { font-size: 0.8rem; }

.friend-history-group {
    background: none;
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--light-grey);
}

.theme-dark-mode .friend-history-group { border: 1px solid var(--border-color); }

.friend-history-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.friend-history-avatar {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--accent-light);
    color: var(--accent);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 1rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.theme-dark-mode .friend-history-avatar { background: var(--accent-dark); }

.friend-history-name {
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    color: var(--dark);
}

.theme-dark-mode .friend-history-name { color: var(--text-primary); }

.friend-history-events {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.3rem;
}

.premium-people {
    text-align:center;
    padding:0.2rem 0 0.5rem 0;
    font-size:0.8rem;
    color:var(--slate);
    border-top:1px solid var(--light-grey);
}

.theme-dark-mode .premium-people { border-top:1px solid var(--border-color); }

/* =================== ОПЛАТА PREMIUM (СБП) ==================== */
.premium-payment-tariffs {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
}

.payment-tariff-btn {
    position: relative;
    padding: 0.5rem 0.4rem;
    border: 2px solid var(--light-grey);
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: var(--white);
    color: var(--slate);
    cursor: pointer;
    font-family: inherit;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.15rem;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.payment-tariff-btn.payment-tariff-active {
    border-color: var(--accent);
    background: var(--accent-light);
}

.payment-tariff-btn .tariff-name {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--slate);
}

.payment-tariff-btn .tariff-price {
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--dark);
}

.payment-tariff-btn.payment-tariff-active .tariff-price {
    color: var(--accent);
}

.payment-tariff-btn .tariff-discount {
    position: absolute;
    top: -8px;
    right: -4px;
    background: var(--gold);
    color: #0F172A;
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
    border-radius: 6px;
    letter-spacing: 0.3px;
}

/* ── QR-код ── */
.payment-qr-wrapper {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: var(--white);
    border: 2px solid var(--light-grey);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 0.6rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    min-height: 200px;
}

.payment-qr-wrapper img {
    width: 200px;
    height: 200px;
    object-fit: contain;
    display: block;
    border-radius: 8px;
}

.payment-qr-placeholder {
    width: 200px;
    height: 200px;
    background: var(--light);
    border: 2px dashed var(--light-grey);
    border-radius: 8px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    text-align: center;
    color: var(--slate);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    padding: 0.8rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
}

.payment-qr-hint {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: var(--slate);
    text-align: center;
    line-height: 1.4;
}

/* ── Инструкция ── */
.payment-instruction {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    align-items: flex-start;
    padding: 0.5rem 0.6rem;
    background: var(--light);
    border: 1px solid var(--light-grey);
    border-radius: 10px;
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    color: var(--slate);
    line-height: 1.4;
    text-align: left;
    margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
}

.payment-instruction i {
    color: var(--accent);
    margin-top: 0.15rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
}

/* ── Тёмная тема ── */
body.theme-dark-mode .payment-tariff-btn {
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    border-color: var(--border-color);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .payment-tariff-btn.payment-tariff-active {
    background: var(--accent-dark);
    border-color: var(--accent);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .payment-tariff-btn .tariff-price {
    color: var(--text-primary);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .payment-tariff-btn.payment-tariff-active .tariff-price {
    color: var(--accent);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .payment-qr-wrapper {
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    border-color: var(--border-color);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .payment-qr-placeholder {
    background: var(--bg-primary);
    border-color: var(--border-color);
    color: var(--text-secondary);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .payment-qr-hint {
    color: var(--text-secondary);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .payment-instruction {
    background: var(--bg-primary);
    border-color: var(--border-color);
    color: var(--text-secondary);
}

/* =================== ВЫБОР ИНВЕНТАРЯ ==================== */
.inventory-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 0.5rem;
}

.inventory-btn {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 0.5rem;
    border: 2px solid var(--light-grey);
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: var(--white);
    cursor: pointer;
    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: inherit;
}

.inventory-btn .inventory-name {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--dark);
}

.inventory-btn.selected { border-color: var(--accent-light); }
.inventory-btn.selected .inventory-name { color: var(--accent); }

body.theme-dark-mode .inventory-btn {
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    border-color: var(--border-color);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .inventory-btn .inventory-name { color: var(--text-primary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .inventory-btn.selected { border-color: var(--accent-dark); }
body.theme-dark-mode .inventory-btn.selected .inventory-name { color: var(--accent); }

.language-icon {
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    background: var(--accent-light);
    color: var(--accent);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

body.theme-dark-mode .language-icon { background: var(--accent-dark); }

.language-option {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.5rem 1rem 0.5rem 0.5rem;
    background: var(--light);
    border-radius: 12px;
    cursor: pointer;
    border: 2px solid transparent;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

body.theme-dark-mode .language-option { background: var(--bg-primary); }
.language-option-active { border-color: var(--accent); }
.language-option-active .theme-option-check { display: flex !important; }

.language-option-check {
    width: 24px;
    height: 24px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--accent);
    color: white;
    display: none;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.language-option-check i { font-size: 0.8rem; }

/* =================== МОДАЛКА: УПРАЖНЕНИЯ ПО ГРУППАМ МЫШЦ ==================== */
.muscle-modal-description {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.7rem;
    text-align: left;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.muscle-modal-text {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: var(--slate);
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0.6rem 0.8rem;
    background: var(--light);
    border-radius: 10px;
    border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
}

.muscle-modal-text strong {
    color: var(--dark);
    font-weight: 700;
}

body.theme-dark-mode .muscle-modal-text {
    background: var(--bg-primary);
    color: var(--text-secondary);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .muscle-modal-text strong { color: var(--text-primary); }

/* =================== ПЛАШКА "ПОЛЬЗОВАТЕЛИ" =================== */
.stats-banner {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    background: var(--white);
    padding: 0.5rem;
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
    margin-top: 0.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.stats-banner-icon {
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: var(--accent-light);
    color: var(--accent);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 1.3rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.stats-banner-text {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.stats-banner-title {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: var(--dark);
    font-weight: 500;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.stats-banner-value {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: var(--slate);
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

body.theme-dark-mode .stats-banner {
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card-dark);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .stats-banner-icon { background: var(--accent-dark); }
body.theme-dark-mode .stats-banner-title { color: var(--text-primary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .stats-banner-value { color: var(--text-secondary); }

/* =================== ДВЕ ПЛЯШКИ В ОДНУ СТРОКУ =================== */
.stats-banners-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin: 0.5rem 0;
}

.stats-banners-row .stats-banner {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0.5rem;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    min-width: 0;
}

.stats-banners-row .stats-banner-icon {
    width: 30px;
    height: 30px;
    min-width: 30px;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    border-radius: 7px;
}

.stats-banners-row .stats-banner-title {
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    line-height: 1.2;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.stats-banners-row .stats-banner-value {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    white-space: normal;
    line-height: 1.2;
}

body.theme-dark-mode .stats-banners-row .stats-banner {
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card-dark);
}

/* =================== ДОСТИЖЕНИЯ СООБЩЕСТВА (ЕДИНАЯ СТЕНКА) =================== */
.community-achievements-wall {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr);
    background: var(--white);
    border-radius: 12px;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
    padding: 0.4rem 0;
    cursor: pointer;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.community-achievement-tile {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    padding: 0.3rem 0.1rem;
    min-height: 56px;
    position: relative;
    min-width: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* ★★★ СТЕНКИ МЕЖДУ ЯЧЕЙКАМИ ★★★ */
.community-achievement-tile:not(:last-child)::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    right: 0;
    top: 20%;
    bottom: 20%;
    width: 1px;
    background: var(--light-grey);
}

.community-achievement-icon {
    font-size: 1rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    line-height: 1;
}

.community-achievement-icon.unlocked { color: var(--gold); }
.community-achievement-icon.locked   { color: var(--light-grey); }

.community-achievement-percent {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--dark);
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    max-width: 100%;
    line-height: 1.1;
}

/* ── Тёмная тема ── */
body.theme-dark-mode .community-achievements-wall {
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card-dark);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .community-achievement-tile:not(:last-child)::after {
    background: var(--border-color);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .community-achievement-icon.locked { color: var(--border-color); }
body.theme-dark-mode .community-achievement-percent      { color: var(--text-primary); }


/* =================== СЕРИЯ ТРЕНИРОВОК =================== */
.profile-streak {
    position: absolute;
    top: 1rem;
    right: 1rem;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.3rem;
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--accent);
    z-index: 2;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.profile-streak i { font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--accent); }

.profile-streak.zero { color: var(--light-grey); }
.profile-streak.zero i { color: var(--light-grey); }

body.theme-dark-mode .profile-streak { color: var(--accent); }
body.theme-dark-mode .profile-streak i { color: var(--accent); }
body.theme-dark-mode .profile-streak.zero { color: var(--border-color); }
body.theme-dark-mode .profile-streak.zero i { color: var(--border-color); }

/* =================== АВТО-КАРУСЕЛЬ (БЕСКОНЕЧНАЯ) ==================== */
.auto-carousel {
    width: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
    -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent 0%, #000 5%, #000 95%, transparent 100%);
    mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent 0%, #000 5%, #000 95%, transparent 100%);
}

.auto-carousel-track {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    width: max-content;
    animation: autoScroll 60s linear infinite;
    will-change: transform;
}

@keyframes autoScroll {
    0% { transform: translateX(0); }
    100% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
}

.carousel-card {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;        /* центр по горизонтали */
    justify-content: flex-end;  /* ★ прижато к низу */
    gap: 0.4rem;
    background: var(--white);
    padding: 0.6rem;
    border-radius: 20px;
    width: 140px;
    min-width: 140px;
    max-width: 140px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
    flex-shrink: 0;
    cursor: pointer;
    user-select: none;
    margin: 0 0 12px;
    text-align: center;
    transition: transform 0.2s ease;
}

/* ★ Фото в карусели */
.carousel-card-img {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;             /* заполняет блок без искажений */
    border-radius: 12px;
    display: block;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* ★ Эмодзи — ровно такой же высоты, чтобы карточки не «прыгали» */
.carousel-card-emoji {
    font-size: 2.4rem;             /* уменьшили с 3.2rem под 80px */
    line-height: 1;
    width: 100%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.carousel-card-emoji {
    font-size: 3.2rem;
    line-height: 1;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
}

.carousel-card-info {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.15rem;
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
}

.carousel-card-title {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--dark);
    line-height: 1.2;
    width: 100%;
    word-break: break-word;
    overflow-wrap: break-word;
}

.carousel-card-desc {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: var(--slate);
    line-height: 1.2;
    width: 100%;
    word-break: break-word;
    overflow-wrap: break-word;
}

/* Тёмная тема */
body.theme-dark-mode .carousel-card {
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card-dark);
}
body.theme-dark-mode .carousel-card-title { color: var(--text-primary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .carousel-card-desc  { color: var(--text-secondary); }

/* =================== ИСТОРИЯ ДРУЗЕЙ =================== */
.friends-history-scroll {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    max-height: 500px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    overflow-x: hidden;
}

.friends-history-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar { display: block; width: 0px; }

/* =================== ПЛАВНОЕ ПОЯВЛЕНИЕ КНОПКИ ==================== */
.hero-buttons {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(10px);
    transition: opacity 0.4s ease, transform 0.4s ease;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.hero-buttons.hero-buttons-ready {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
    pointer-events: auto;
}

/* =================== ЕЖЕМЕСЯЧНЫЕ ЗНАЧКИ =================== */
.monthly-badges-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 1rem;
    margin: 1rem 0rem;
}

.month-badge {
    width: 56px;
    height: 56px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
    border: 2px solid var(--light-grey);
    background: var(--light-grey);
    filter: grayscale(1) opacity(0.45);
    user-select: none;
}

.month-badge.golden {
    background: var(--accent-light);
    border-color: var(--accent);
    filter: none;
}

.month-badge-emoji {
    font-size: 1.7rem;
    line-height: 1;
    pointer-events: none;
}

body.theme-dark-mode .month-badge {
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    border-color: var(--border-color);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .month-badge.golden {
    background: var(--accent-dark);
    border-color: var(--accent);
}

.level-bar-modal {
    width: 100%;
    height: 8px;
    background: var(--light-grey);
    border-radius: 4px;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
}

.level-fill-modal {
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: var(--accent);
    animation: fillBar 3s ease;
}

body.theme-dark-mode .level-bar-modal { background: var(--bg-secondary); }

/* =================== QR-КОД ПРОФИЛЯ =================== */
.qr-code-wrapper {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: var(--light);
    padding: 1rem;
    border-radius: 16px;
    border: 2px solid var(--light-grey);
    margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
}

.qr-code-wrapper canvas {
    display: block;
    max-width: 100%;
    height: auto;
}

.qr-code-name {
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--dark);
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
    word-break: break-word;
}

body.theme-dark-mode .qr-code-name { color: var(--text-primary); }

.qr-code-hint {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--slate);
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

body.theme-dark-mode .qr-code-wrapper {
    background: var(--bg-primary);
    border-color: var(--border-color);
}

/* =================== УЧАСТНИКИ СОВМЕСТНОЙ ТРЕНИРОВКИ ==================== */
.coop-participant-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem;
    background: var(--accent-light);
    border-radius: 6px;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
}

body.theme-dark-mode .coop-participant-item { background: var(--accent-dark); }

/* =================== СТАТУС ДРУЗЕЙ НА СТРАНИЦЕ ОЖИДАНИЯ ==================== */
.coop-friend-status-item {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem;
    background: var(--white);
    border-radius: 10px;
    border: 1px solid var(--light-grey);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
}

.coop-friend-status-name {
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--dark);
    font-size: 0.8rem;
}

.coop-friend-status-progress {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--slate);
    font-size: 0.8rem;
}

body.theme-dark-mode .coop-friend-status-item {
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card-dark);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .coop-friend-status-name { color: var(--text-primary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .coop-friend-status-progress { color: var(--text-secondary); }

/* =================== КНОПКИ НА ФИНИШЕ ==================== */
.finish-btn-container {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    width: 100%;
    margin-top: 0.5rem;
}

/* =================== TOGGLE GROUP С КНОПКОЙ > ==================== */
.toggle-group-with-arrow {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    width: 100%;
    height: 34px;
}

.toggle-group-with-arrow .toggle-group {
    flex: 1;
    height: 34px;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
}

.toggle-group-with-arrow .toggle-btn {
    padding: 0;
    height: 100%;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    border-radius: 8px;
}

.toggle-group-with-arrow .btn-submit-arrow {
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* =================== АНИМАЦИЯ ЭКРАНОВ HERO / LOADING ==================== */

/* Разрешаем иконке выйти за границы фичи во время scale() */
#page-loading .feature,
#page-hero .feature {
    overflow: visible;
}

#page-loading .feature i,
#page-hero .feature i {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    transform-origin: center center;
    will-change: transform;
}

#page-loading .feature span,
#page-hero .feature span {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    will-change: opacity, transform;
}

/* ★ ОБЩИЕ ПАРАМЕТРЫ ВСЕХ АНИМАЦИЙ ★ */
#page-loading.loading-animate .feature i,
#page-loading.loading-animate .feature span,
#page-hero.loading-animate .feature i,
#page-hero.loading-animate .feature span {
    animation-duration: 0.9s;
    animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.3, 0.64, 1);
    animation-fill-mode: both;
    animation-delay: 1s;
}

/* ── Фича 1 ── */
#page-loading.loading-animate .feature:nth-child(1) i,
#page-hero.loading-animate .feature:nth-child(1) i {
    animation-name: featureIconIn;
    animation-delay: 1.0s;
}
#page-loading.loading-animate .feature:nth-child(1) span,
#page-hero.loading-animate .feature:nth-child(1) span {
    animation-name: featureTextIn;
    animation-delay: 1.0s;
}

/* ── Фича 2 ── */
#page-loading.loading-animate .feature:nth-child(2) i,
#page-hero.loading-animate .feature:nth-child(2) i {
    animation-name: featureIconIn;
    animation-delay: 1.6s;
}
#page-loading.loading-animate .feature:nth-child(2) span,
#page-hero.loading-animate .feature:nth-child(2) span {
    animation-name: featureTextIn;
    animation-delay: 1.6s;
}

/* ── Фича 3 ── */
#page-loading.loading-animate .feature:nth-child(3) i,
#page-hero.loading-animate .feature:nth-child(3) i {
    animation-name: featureIconIn;
    animation-delay: 2.2s;
}
#page-loading.loading-animate .feature:nth-child(3) span,
#page-hero.loading-animate .feature:nth-child(3) span {
    animation-name: featureTextIn;
    animation-delay: 2.2s;
}

/* Иконка: большая → обычная */
@keyframes featureIconIn {
    0%   { transform: scale(1.5) translateY(0.35em); }
    100% { transform: scale(1) translateY(0); }
}

/* Текст: прозрачный + сверху → видимый + на месте */
@keyframes featureTextIn {
    0%   { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-10px); }
    100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

/* =================== ОБУЧЕНИЕ: СКРЫТЬ ПУЗЫРЁК НА ШАГЕ 1 ==================== */
.bottom-nav.tutorial-hide-bubble .nav-bubble {
    opacity: 0 !important;
    transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
}

/* Пустое состояние графика */
.body-progress-empty-state {
    background: none;
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 1.5rem 1rem 1.3rem;
    text-align: center;
    min-height: 200px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* Легкая клетка на фоне для настроения */
.body-progress-empty-state::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background-image:
        linear-gradient(rgba(100, 100, 100, 0.04) 1px, transparent 1px),
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(100, 100, 100, 0.04) 1px, transparent 1px);
    background-size: 20px 20px;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.body-progress-empty-icon {
    font-size: 2.8rem;
    line-height: 1;
    margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

.body-progress-empty-title {
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--dark);
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

.body-progress-empty-text {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--slate);
    line-height: 1.5;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

/* Тёмная тема */
body.theme-dark-mode .body-progress-empty-state {
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    border-color: var(--border-color);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .body-progress-empty-state::before {
    background-image:
        linear-gradient(rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) 1px, transparent 1px),
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) 1px, transparent 1px);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .body-progress-empty-title {
    color: var(--text-primary);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .body-progress-empty-text {
    color: var(--text-secondary);
}

/* =================== ПРОСМОТР ДАННЫХ ПРОГРЕССА ТЕЛА ==================== */
.body-params-row {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: nowrap;      /* ★ Запрещаем перенос */
    gap: 0.3rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
}

.body-param-btn {
    flex: 1 1 0;            /* ★ Равные доли */
    min-width: 0;           /* ★ Разрешаем сжиматься */
    padding: 0.3rem 0.2rem;
    border: 2px solid var(--light-grey);
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: var(--white);
    color: var(--slate);
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-family: inherit;
    text-align: center;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.body-param-btn.active {
    border-color: var(--accent);
    color: var(--accent);
    border: 2px solid var(--accent);
}

.body-view-chart {
    background: var(--light);
    border: 1px solid var(--light-grey);
    border-radius: 12px;
    min-height: auto;
    padding: 0.3rem;
}

/* ── Элемент истории ── */
.body-history-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    background: var(--white);
    padding: 0.5rem 0.6rem;
    border-radius: 10px;
    border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
}

.body-history-info {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
    text-align: left;
}

.body-history-date {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--dark);
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.body-history-value {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--accent);
}

.body-history-actions {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.2rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.body-history-btn {
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    border: none;
    background: transparent;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    transition: background 0.2s ease;
}

.body-history-btn.edit   { color: var(--accent); }
.body-history-btn.delete { color: var(--danger); }

.body-history-btn:active { background: var(--light); }

/* ── Тёмная тема ── */
body.theme-dark-mode .body-param-btn {
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    border-color: var(--border-color);
    color: var(--text-secondary);
}
body.theme-dark-mode .body-param-btn.active {
    border-color: var(--accent);
    color: var(--accent);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .body-view-chart {
    background: var(--bg-primary);
    border-color: var(--border-color);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .body-history-item {
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card-dark);
}
body.theme-dark-mode .body-history-date { color: var(--text-primary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .body-history-value { color: var(--accent); }

body.theme-dark-mode .body-history-btn:active { background: var(--bg-primary); }

:root {
    --chart-dot-stroke: #FFFFFF;
}

body.theme-dark-mode {
    --chart-dot-stroke: #1E293B;
}

/* =================== ЮРИДИЧЕСКИЕ ДОКУМЕНТЫ =================== */
.legal-text {
    text-align: left;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    line-height: 1.55;
    color: var(--slate);
    background: var(--light);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 0.8rem 1rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
}

/* ★ Обёртка задаёт высоту и скролл ★ */
.legal-text-wrapper,
.scroll-wrapper:has(.legal-text) {
    max-height: 55vh;
    overflow-y: auto;
    scrollbar-width: thin;
    margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
    border-radius: 10px;
}

/* Тонкий скроллбар в WebKit */
.scroll-wrapper:has(.legal-text)::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 4px;
}
.scroll-wrapper:has(.legal-text)::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: var(--light-grey);
    border-radius: 4px;
}
.scroll-wrapper:has(.legal-text)::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: transparent;
}

.legal-text h3 {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--dark);
    margin: 0.8rem 0 0.3rem;
}
.legal-text h3:first-child { margin-top: 0; }

.legal-text p { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; }
.legal-text ul { padding-left: 1.2rem; margin: 0 0 0.5rem; }
.legal-text li { margin-bottom: 0.2rem; }

.legal-text strong { color: var(--dark); }

.legal-updated {
    display: block;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--slate);
    margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
}

/* ── Чекбокс согласия в регистрации ── */
.consent-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin-top: 0.8rem;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--slate);
    line-height: 1.4;
    text-align: left;
}

.consent-row input[type="checkbox"] {
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    margin-top: 0.15rem;
    appearance: none;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    border: 2px solid var(--slate);
    border-radius: 5px;
    background: var(--white);
    cursor: pointer;
    position: relative;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.consent-row input[type="checkbox"]:checked {
    background: var(--accent);
    border-color: var(--accent);
}

.consent-row input[type="checkbox"]:checked::after {
    content: '✓';
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    color: var(--white);
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
}

.consent-row input[type="checkbox"].error {
    border-color: var(--danger);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15);
}

.consent-row a {
    color: var(--accent);
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-underline-offset: 2px;
    cursor: pointer;
}

/* ── Тёмная тема ── */
body.theme-dark-mode .legal-text {
    background: var(--bg-primary);
    color: var(--text-secondary);
}
body.theme-dark-mode .legal-text h3,
body.theme-dark-mode .legal-text strong { color: var(--text-primary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .legal-text .legal-updated { color: var(--text-secondary); }

body.theme-dark-mode .consent-row input[type="checkbox"] {
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    border-color: var(--border-color);
}
body.theme-dark-mode .consent-row input[type="checkbox"]:checked {
    background: var(--accent);
    border-color: var(--accent);
}

/* =================== ЗАПРЕТ СКРОЛЛА НА СЕССИИ ==================== */
html.no-scroll,
body.no-scroll {
    overflow: hidden !important;
    height: 100% !important;
    overscroll-behavior: none !important;
    touch-action: pan-y;   /* вертикальные жесты не скроллят страницу */
}

/* =================== КНОПКА ПОДЕЛИТЬСЯ ТРЕНИРОВКОЙ ==================== */
.workout-share-btn {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    width: 36px;
    height: 20px;
    border: none;
    background: var(--light);
    color: var(--slate);
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    border-radius: 10px;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}


body.theme-dark-mode .workout-share-btn {
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    color: var(--text-primary);
}

/* =================== ЛЕНТА ==================== */
.feed-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.8rem;
}

/* Карточка поста */
.feed-post {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;      /* ← шапка сверху, контент снизу */
    gap: 0.5rem;                 /* ← отступ между блоками */
    background: transparent;     /* ← общего фона больше нет */
    padding: 0;
}

/* Шапка — отдельный блок, прозрачный */
.feed-post-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.6rem;
    padding: 0;
    background: transparent;
}

/* Аватар — квадрат со скруглёнными углами */
.feed-post-avatar {
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    min-width: 40px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--white);
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
}

.feed-post-avatar img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: contain;
    display: block;
    border-radius: 50%;
}

/* Внутренняя акцентная обводка, как у профиля */
.feed-post-avatar::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    border-radius: 50%;
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px var(--accent);
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 2;
}

body.theme-dark-mode .feed-post-avatar {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--white);
}

.feed-post-info { flex: 1; min-width: 0; text-align: left; }

.feed-post-name {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--dark);
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.feed-post-time {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: var(--slate);
}

/* Кнопка действия справа (мусорка или скачать) */
.feed-post-action-btn {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    border: none;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--slate);
    font-size: 1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    border-radius: 8px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 0;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

.feed-post-action-btn .fa-trash-can { color: var(--danger); }

/* Контент — отдельный блок со своим фоном и скруглением */
.feed-post-content {
    position: relative;
    background: var(--white);
    border-radius: 16px;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
    overflow: hidden;
    aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
}

/* Фото внутри контента */
.feed-post-image {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    background: var(--light);
}

.feed-post-image img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    display: block;
}

/* Градиент под статистику */
.feed-post-image::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
    height: 55%;
    background: linear-gradient(
        to top,
        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75) 0%,
        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35) 45%,
        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 100%
    );
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 1;
}

/* Тело со статистикой — поверх фото, прижато к низу */
.feed-post-body {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
    padding: 0.8rem;
    z-index: 2;
    text-align: left;
}

.feed-post-title {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--white);
    margin-bottom: 0.1rem;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    text-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}

.feed-post-stats {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 0.3rem;
}

.feed-post-stat {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 0.2rem;
    text-align: center;
}

.feed-post-stat-label {
    display: block;
    font-size: 0.5rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.3px;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.feed-post-stat-value {
    display: block;
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--white);
    white-space: nowrap;
}

/* =================== ПОИСК ПО ЛЕНТЕ — «DYNAMIC ISLAND» ==================== */
.feed-search-panel {
    position: sticky;
    top: calc(0.5rem + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px));
    z-index: 10;
    margin: 0.5rem 0 0.75rem 0;
    padding: 0.35rem;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85) !important;   /* ★ СВЕТЛЫЙ в светлой теме */
    backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(180%);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(180%);
    border-radius: 999px;
    box-shadow:
        0 8px 24px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12),
        0 2px 6px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08),
        inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9),
        0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
    transition:
        transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1),
        opacity 0.25s ease;
    will-change: transform;
}

.feed-search-panel.search-hidden {
    transform: translateY(-140%);
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.feed-search-panel .search-container {
    margin-bottom: 0;
    gap: 0.3rem;
}

.feed-search-panel .search-input {
    background: var(--white);
    border: none !important;
    color: var(--dark) !important;      /* ★ ТЁМНЫЙ текст на светлом */
    padding: 0.5rem;
    max-height: none;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    border-radius: 999px;
}

.feed-search-panel .search-input:focus {
    border: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
}

.feed-search-panel .search-input::placeholder {
    color: var(--slate) !important;     /* ★ серый плейсхолдер */
    font-style: italic;
}

.feed-search-panel .search-btn {
    width: 34px;
    height: 34px;
    min-width: 34px;
    max-width: 34px;
    max-height: 34px;
    padding: 0;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border-bottom: none;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    background: var(--accent);
    box-shadow: 0 2px 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent);
}

/* ★ Тёмная тема — снова тёмная пилюля */
body.theme-dark-mode .feed-search-panel {
    background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.92) !important;
    box-shadow:
        0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5),
        0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3),
        inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08),
        inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .feed-search-panel .search-input {
    color: #FFFFFF !important;
}

body.theme-dark-mode .feed-search-panel .search-input::placeholder {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5) !important;
}

/* =================== ЛАЙКИ В ЛЕНТЕ ==================== */
.feed-post-footer {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
}

.feed-like-btn {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.35rem;
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    color: var(--slate);
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0.3rem 0.5rem;
    border-radius: 8px;
    transition: color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

.feed-like-btn:active {
    background: var(--light);
}

.feed-like-btn i {
    font-size: 1rem;
}

.feed-like-btn.liked {
    color: var(--accent);
}

/* ★ Пульс — только когда класс добавляется вручную при клике */
.feed-like-btn.like-pulse i {
    animation: likePulse 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
}

@keyframes likePulse {
    0%   { transform: scale(1); }
    50%  { transform: scale(1.3); }
    100% { transform: scale(1); }
}

body.theme-dark-mode .feed-like-btn {
    color: var(--text-secondary);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .feed-like-btn:active {
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .feed-like-btn.liked {
    color: var(--accent);
}

/* =================== СКАЧИВАНИЯ ТРЕНИРОВКИ В ЛЕНТЕ ==================== */
.feed-download-stat {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.35rem;
    color: var(--slate);
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    padding: 0.3rem 0.5rem;
    border-radius: 8px;
    user-select: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    transition: color 0.2s ease;
}

.feed-download-stat.downloaded {
    color: var(--accent);
}

.feed-download-stat:active {
    background: var(--light);
}

.feed-download-stat i {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
}

body.theme-dark-mode .feed-download-stat {
    color: var(--text-secondary);
}

body.theme-dark-mode .feed-download-stat:active {
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
}

/* ★ Явное правило — иначе специфичность выше у body.theme-dark-mode */
body.theme-dark-mode .feed-download-stat.downloaded {
    color: var(--accent);
}

/* =================== ИКОНКА «+» В НИЖНЕЙ НАВИГАЦИИ НА ЛЕНТЕ ==================== */
.nav-item[data-is-create-post="true"] i {
    font-size: 20px;
    color: var(--accent);
    transform: scale(1.05);
    filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent));
}

body.theme-dark-mode .nav-item[data-is-create-post="true"] i {
    color: var(--accent);
}

/* =================== ЗОНА ЗАГРУЗКИ ФОТО ==================== */
.upload-zone {
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
    border: 2px dashed var(--light-grey);
    border-radius: 12px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    background: var(--light);
    margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
}

.upload-zone img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    display: block;
}

.upload-zone-icon {
    font-size: 2.5rem;
    color: var(--slate);
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
}

.upload-zone-text {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: var(--slate);
    padding: 0 1rem;
    text-align: center;
}

/* =================== ОПЦИЯ «ССЫЛКА НА ТРЕНИРОВКУ» В МОДАЛКЕ ==================== */
.post-toggle-row {
    background: var(--light);
    border: 1px solid var(--light-grey);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 0.6rem 0.8rem;
    margin-top: 0.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    user-select: none;
}

.post-checkbox-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--dark);
    cursor: pointer;
}

.post-checkbox-row input[type="checkbox"] {
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    appearance: none;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    border: 2px solid var(--slate);
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: var(--white);
    cursor: pointer;
    position: relative;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.post-checkbox-row input[type="checkbox"]:checked {
    background: var(--accent);
    border-color: var(--accent);
}

.post-checkbox-row input[type="checkbox"]:checked::after {
    content: '✓';
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    color: var(--white);
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
}

body.theme-dark-mode .post-toggle-row {
    background: var(--bg-primary);
    border-color: var(--border-color);
}
body.theme-dark-mode .post-checkbox-row { color: var(--text-primary); }
body.theme-dark-mode .post-checkbox-row input[type="checkbox"] {
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    border-color: var(--border-color);
}
body.theme-dark-mode .post-checkbox-row input[type="checkbox"]:checked {
    background: var(--accent);
    border-color: var(--accent);
}

/* =================== КНОПКА «ДОБАВИТЬ ТРЕНИРОВКУ» В ПОСТЕ ==================== */
.feed-post-action-btn {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
